Bug.name: Attack Order
Bug.description:
You summon your underlings to attack a foe.
Make a ranged attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE
bug damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on rolls
of 19 or 20.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Blood Shield
Bug.description: You conjure a shield equal to melee damage you have dealt. Gain a shield equal to the damage you dealt since the beginning your last turn. The shield effect will not stack if used consecutively.

Bug.name: Bug Bite
Bug.description:
You lash out and bite a foe. Make a melee attack
against an opponent, dealing 1d10 + MOVE bug damage on
a hit. If the target is holding a berry when you hit, you
immediately eat it and gain its effect.
Bug.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Bug Buzz
Bug.description: You vibrate your wings, creating a harsh sound that damages any creature in range. All creatures within 20 feet of you must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE bug damage on a fail. If an opponent fails the save by more than 5, they have disadvantage on their next attack.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Defend Order
Bug.description:
You summon forth your underlings to form a
natural shield in front of you. For the duration, as long as
you keep your concentration, gain +1 to your AC.
Bug.scaling:
The AC boost for this move changes to +2 at
level 5, +3 at level 10, and +4 at level 17.

Bug.name: Fell Stinger
Bug.description: You lunge at a creature with a devastating sting attack. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. If this attack causes the target to faint, double your ability modifier for attack rolls and damage on your next turn.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: First Impression
Bug.description: You make quite the entrance, quickly attacking a creature. This attack can only be used on the first turn that the user has entered combat. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. This move may go first the initiative order if you have a valid target.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Fury Cutter
Bug.description: You unleash series of cuts against a creature that increase in strength. When you activate this move, make a melee attack on a target in range, doing 1d4 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. If you continue to use this move on consecutive turns, double the dice roll for damage and increase VP cost by 1 each time you hit. The multiplier maxes out at 8x the original damage. The damage resets if any of the attacks miss, or if you are incapacitated.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Heal Order
Bug.description: You summon forth your underlings to heal your wounds. Regain 4d4 + MOVE hit points.
Bug.scaling: The healing dice roll for this move changes to 3d6 at level 5, 5d6 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Infestation
Bug.description: You summon an infestation of tiny insects to attack a creature for multiple turns. Make a ranged attack on a target. On a hit, the target takes 1d4 + MOVE bug damage and becomes infested for 1d4 rounds. An infested creature must make a CON save against your Move DC at the beginning of each of its turns, taking 1d4 + MOVE bug damage on a failed save.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Bug.name: Leech Life
Bug.description: You attempt to suck away some of a creature’s life force. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. Half of the damage done is restored to the user.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Lunge
Bug.description: You make a lunge at the target, attacking with full force. Make a melee attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE Bug damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 15 or more, the target has disadvantage on its next attack.
Bug.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes
to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Megahorn
Bug.description: You charge at a creature for a devastating horn attack. Make a melee attack roll, doing 3d10 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. If the user moves at least 20 feet towards a target before using this move, the target is forced to make a STR save against your Move DC or be knocked prone.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Piercing Lance
Bug.description: You stab an opponent with an imposing, lance-like appendage. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical hit on a natural attack roll of 16 or higher. On a critical hit, the target becomes frightened of you.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 6, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Pin Missile
Bug.description: You strike a creature with sharp projectiles in quick succession. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another projectile hits again for an additional 1d4 bug damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice rolls for this move change to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Pollen Puff
Bug.description: You send forth a flurry of pollen at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. If the target is an ally, it heals for half the amount of the damage roll instead.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Powder
Bug.description: You coat a creature in an explosive powder, which will ignite if exposed to fire. The powder remains on the target until the target washes it off with water or spends 1 minute cleaning it off manually, but becomes neutralized after 1 hour. When this powder expodes, it automatically deals 3d10 fire damage to the creature coated by it. When a creature in range other than yourself activates a damaging fire-type move, you may use your reaction to release a spray of flammable powder that explodes as it hits either the user or a creature affected by the fire move. In the case of this move being used as a reaction, the target may attempt a Dexterity saving throw, taking half damage on a success.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Powder Cloud
Bug.description: You emit a cloud of fine, explosive powder in a 20ft. radius around you, respecting physical boundaries, which will ignite on contact with fire. When this powder expodes, all creatures affected must succeed a Dexterity saving throw, taking 4d12 fire damage on a failed save, half as much on a success. After the initial use of this move, it will spread out by 5 feet per round until the cloud covers a 40ft. radius. The powder lingers in the air for 1 hour before it settles and becomes neutralized.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Bug.name: Quiver Dance
Bug.description: You lightly perform a mystical dance. For the duration, add +1 to your AC, attack rolls, and damage.
Bug.scaling: Add +2 to your AC at level 10 and above.

Bug.name: Rage Powder
Bug.description: You scatter a cloud of irritating powder, drawing attacks to yourself. Any creature in a 15 foot cone must make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the creature(s) can only use damaging moves that target you for the duration. Any creature affected can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns to shake off the effect.

Bug.name: Signal Beam
Bug.description: A flashing beam strikes a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the beam confuses the target.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Silver Wind
Bug.description: You strike a target with a battering wind of silver dust. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. On a natural roll of 19 or 20, all of your ability scores go up by 1 while you remain in battle. This move can be stacked for a maximum of +5 to all ability scores.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Spider Web
Bug.description: You fire a sticky web that attempts to restrain a creature. Make a ranged attack roll on a target in range. On a hit, the target is covered in web. While covered, it is restrained and cannot flee or be switched out. The target can use an action on its turn to escape with a STR save against your Move DC.

Bug.name: Steamroller
Bug.description: You roll up your body and roll over a creature. Make a melee attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. If your natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target flinches.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Sticky Web
Bug.description: You quickly fire a sticky web at a creature entering the battle. When a creature is switched into battle, you may use your reaction to make a ranged attack on the creature. On a hit, the target is restrained The creature may make a STR save against your Move DC at the beginning of each of its turns to escape the web.

Bug.name: String Shot
Bug.description: You unleash sticky string at a creature in range, slowing it down. Make a ranged attack roll against a target. On a hit, the target’s speed is reduced by 10 for the duration. The move is stackable to any amount. The target may take an action to attempt to get rid of any string with a STR save against your Move DC. If this reduction in speed causes their speed to be 0, they are restrained.

Bug.name: Struggle Bug
Bug.description: You resist an attack, fighting back against a creature. When hit by a melee attack, you may use a reaction to immediately retaliate with an attack roll of your own, dealing 1d6 + MOVE bug damage on a hit.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Bug.name: Swarm
Bug.description:
You call for allies to aid you in battle. 1d4 + MOVE non-evolved Pokémon of the same species appear within a 20ft. radius. Your allies go after you in the initiative order, and are half your level, rounded up. While in your natural habitat, gain advantage on the summoning roll. The allies will follow your command, but scatter after 5 rounds. If you are not in your natural habitat, the allies will appear as ethereal manifestations.
This move may only be used once per short rest.
Bug.scaling: The summoning dice roll for this move changes to 2d4 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 15.

Bug.name: Tail Glow
Bug.description: Your tail emits a flash of light, boosting your attack. For the duration, double your STAB damage.

Bug.name: Transfusion
Bug.description: You latch on to a creature, attempting to drain its life energy. Make an attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. You regain of the damage dealt as HP. The target must then succeed a Strength saving throw or become grappled by you. While you have grappled an opponent, you may use this move as a bonus action.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10 and 4d8 at level 17

Bug.name: Twineedle
Bug.description: You fire two sharp projectiles at a creature in range. They do not have to target the same creature. Make two ranged attack rolls, dealing 1d4 + MOVE bug damage on each hit. If the natural roll of either attack is a 19 or 20, the target is poisoned.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Bug.name: U-turn
Bug.description: You lash out with a quick strike before you make a getaway. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit. After this move is activated, if it is possible, you must either move up to half your movement speed away from your target, not provoking opportunity attacks, or your trainer must switch you out as a free action.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Bug.name: Wing Buffer
Bug.description: You beat your wings at an incredible frequency, creating an air cushion that buffers damage towards you. Until your next turn. any successful hit against you triggers a Dexterity saving throw for you, against their move DC. On a successful save, you take half damage.

Bug.name: X-Scissor
Bug.description: You cross your claws for a scissor-like slashing attack. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE bug damage on a hit.
Bug.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Ascension
Cosmic.description: You point at a creature in range, speaking an ancient blessing that temporarily grants them the ability to fly with a set of ethereal wings. Their flight speed becomes 30ft. for the duration.

Cosmic.name: Astral Shift
Cosmic.description:
You project a duplicate image of yourself 5 feet beside you. The image copies every move you make. When an enemy hits you with an attack, roll a d6. On a 1, the image absorbs half the damage. On a 2 or 3, the image absorbs half the damage, and you take damage to VP instead of HP. On a 4 or 5, the image absorbs all damage and allows you to teleport for half your movement speed to an unoccupied space. On a 6, the image absorbs all damage and shifts back into you, making your next attack deal double damage.
Every time this move is used in the same encounter, its VP cost is doubled from its previous cost.

Cosmic.name: Blink
Cosmic.description: You instantly teleport within 5ft of a light source that is in range. It happens so blindingly fast that creatures can't make opportunity attacks against you. This move can also be used as a reaction to dodge an incoming attack: When subject to an attack or AOE move, roll an Acrobatics check (DM's discretion), performing this move on a success.

Cosmic.name: Breach in Time
Cosmic.description:
You begin to focus your temporal energies. This requires concentration and uses your action and movement on each turn. After 10 rounds of concentration, you tear open the existing wound in time that you embody, creating a temporary portal in its space. The portal connects to either a random point in time in the same locatio, a location in the Sea of Dreams plane, or a point elsewhere in the current timeline within 10 miles. 

The portal remains open for 1 minute. Any creature that passes through faces the inherent dangers of temporal displacement. After using this ability, Temporis can't use it again for 7 days.

Cosmic.name: Call of Ouroboros
Cosmic.description: While grounded, you recite the ancient vows of your sworn soldiers to the ground, calling forth a guard of Venomire to aid you. Roll 4d4, summoning that many Venomire around you. The Venomire guard are half of your level, and will vanish if defeated. They will target objectives set by you, but you do not control them directly. They can't be caught. This move may only be used once per encounter.
Cosmic.scaling: From level 17, one of the summoned guards is a level 15 Venolisk.

Cosmic.name: Call of the Underworld
Cosmic.description: While grounded, you recite the ancient vows of your sworn soldiers to the ground, calling forth a guard of Hadean to aid you. Roll 4d4, summoning that many Hadean minions around you. The Hadean guard are half of your level, and will vanish if defeated. They will target objectives set by you, but you do not control them directly. They can't be caught. This move may only be used once per encounter.
Cosmic.scaling: From level 17, one of the summoned guards is a level 15 Styxxil.

Cosmic.name: Celestial Aura
Cosmic.description: You call upon a celestial force to come to your aid. For the duration, you have advantage on all saving throws and receive +2 to your INT and WIS stats.
Cosmic.scaling: After level 16, the stat bonus is increased to +4.

Cosmic.name: Chaos Beam
Cosmic.moveStat:
Roll 1d6:
1: STR
2: DEX
3: CON
4: INT
5: WIS
6: CHA
Cosmic.description:
You tap into the elemental energy field around you, and release a powerful blast of concentrated elemental energy. All creatures caught in the line have to succeed a DEX saving throw or take 4d12 + MOVE damage. Roll a d20 to determine the damage type:
1: Bug
2: Dark
3: Dragon
4: Electric:
5: Fairy
6: Fighting
7: Fire
8: Flying
9: Ghost
10: Grass
11: Ground
12: Ice
13: Normal
14: Poison
15: Psychic
16: Rock
17: Steel
18: Water
19: Cosmic
20: Typeless
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Convergence
Cosmic.description: You call down the combined light of every star it has ever seen. This devastating attack affects all hostile creatures within range. All creatures in the affected zone must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 20d12 + MOVE Cosmic damage on a failure or half on a success. Additionally, the intense stellar energy permanently changes the landscape within the area (creating crystal formations, changing terrain type, etc.). Friendly creatures in the area are protected from the blast. This move can only be used when Jirachi's third eye is fully open.

Cosmic.name: Cosmic Power
Cosmic.description:
You call upon a mystic force to come to your aid.
For the duration, you have advantage on all saving throws.

Cosmic.name: Cosmic Pulse
Cosmic.description: You emit a wave of cosmic energy affecting all creatures in range, ignoring cover. Make a single ranged attack roll for all creatures, dealing 3d10 + MOVE cosmic damage to every creature hit. On a critical hit, all targets must succeed a CON save or suffer the Blink effect until the end of their next turn.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Cosmic Ward
Cosmic.description:
You surround yourself with a protective aura, granting immunity from status conditions and resistance from one random damage type for 1 minute.
The resistance overrides your type. Re-roll your damage type resistance every round of the effect.

Roll a d20:
1: Bug
2: Dark
3: Dragon
4: Electric:
5: Fairy
6: Fighting
7: Fire
8: Flying
9: Ghost
10: Grass
11: Ground
12: Ice
13: Normal
14: Poison
15: Psychic
16: Rock
17: Steel
18: Water
19: Cosmic
20: Your choice
Cosmic.scaling: From level 18 you gain three random resistances instead of one.

Cosmic.name: Dimension Slash
Cosmic.description: You slash at an opponent in range. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE cosmic damage on a hit. The creature hit must succeed a Constitution saving throw or be affected by the Blink effect for 1 minute.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Doom Desire
Cosmic.description: You promise doom upon an opponent. When you activate this move, select a target and make an attack roll. On a hit, the target is marked with impending doom. At the beginning of the third round after activation, the marked creature takes 10d12 + MOVE cosmic damage, regardless of its location.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Dragon Ascent
Cosmic.description: You soar through the air at blistering speed, ripping into an opponent in range with your claws. Make a melee attack on an opponent, doing 2d8 + MOVE dragon damage on a hit. You return to your original position after a successful attack. You do not incur opportunity attacks while using this move.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Erasure
Cosmic.description: Once while Jirachi's third eye is open, you may attempt to temporarily remove a target from existence. The target must make a Charisma saving throw with disadvantage. On a failure, they are removed from reality for 1d4 rounds-they don't exist during this time and cannot be affected by anything. Other creatures forget they existed during the erasure. When they return, they take 14d12 Cosmic damage and are stunned for 1 round as reality reasserts their existence. Legendary creatures and beings with strong planar connections have advantage on the save.

Cosmic.name: Graviton Beam
Cosmic.description: You emit a concentrated beam of gravitational energy at a target within range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE psychic damage on a hit. The target must then make a STR saving throw, falling prone with movement speed halved for 1 minute on a failure. While under the effect of this move, the target can't leave the ground, flee or be switched out. Flying or hovering creatures fall to the ground on a hit, taking fall damage when appropriate.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Gravity
Cosmic.description: You strengthen gravity in a 40 foot sphere, centered on you. Any creature in the area loses their flying/hovering speed, cannot use moves like Fly or Bounce, flying types lose their ground type resistance, and the Levitate ability is suppressed.

Cosmic.name: Gravity Well
Cosmic.description: The user manipulates gravity in a 30-foot radius sphere centered on a point within 100 feet. The area becomes difficult terrain until the beginning of the user's next turn, and any creature that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be knocked prone.

Cosmic.name: Hyperspace Hole
Cosmic.description: You create a portal that allows you to instantly teleport to a creature in range and strike out with a melee attack. This move is guaranteed to hit for 2d8 + MOVE cosmic damage. Reactions that negate damage such as Protect or Detect cannot be used.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Judgment
Cosmic.description: You send powerful missiles of pure energy to rain down on any creature in a 40 foot circle, centered on a point in range. All creatures caught in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 10d12 + MOVE damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The type of the damage depends on the kind of plate the user is holding. This move can only be used once per long rest.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Lunar Dance
Cosmic.description:
You sacrifice yourself for another one of your
trainer's Pokémon. When activating this move, the user
faints, but the next creature released by its trainer is fully
healed and cured of any status effects.

Cosmic.name: Meteor Swarm
Cosmic.description: You call down a swarm of small meteors in a 50ft radius of yourself. Make as many ranged attacks as there are targets in range, dealing 3d10 + MOVE cosmic damage on a hit.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Paradigm Shift
Cosmic.description: You channel the power to change the world in an immense barrage of energy. Make a ranged attack roll against a target within range, dealing 4d12 + MOVE damage on hit. The damage type changes to be super effective against the target.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Phase
Cosmic.description: You temporarily phase out of this plane of existence, becoming partially incorporeal. You may move up to 30ft. through solid matter. You may not end your turn inside solid matter. While phasing, you will not trigger opportunity attacks.

Cosmic.name: Probability Storm
Cosmic.description: For 1 minute, all probability within the area becomes wildly unstable. Any time a creature rolls a d20 within the area, they must roll twice and use the result chosen by Jirachi. Additionally, seemingly impossible events may occur (weapons transforming into flowers, gravity briefly reversing, etc.) at the GM's discretion. Jirachi can end this effect early as a bonus action.

Cosmic.name: Protostar
Cosmic.description:
This move can only be activated while Black Hole is active. A new star begins forming at your core. For the next 3 turns, you regain 3d10 HP at the start of each turn. While this effect is active, you are invisible within the Black Hole.
When this effect ends (or if Black Hole ends early), the darkness ignites. You regain additional HP equal to your level × 3. All creatures still inside Black Hole are pushed to the edge and must make a CON save or be blinded for 1 minute by the brilliant light. The Black Hole then ends.
If you are reduced to 0 HP while this effect is active, the effect ends immediately with no final burst.
Cosmic.scaling: The healing dice changes to 4d10 at level 5, 5d10 at level 10, and 6d10 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Reality Bend
Cosmic.description: Reality becomes distorted around you in a 60ft. radius sphere. When creatures enter the distortion zone, they must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or become confused. For the duration, all creatures within the distortion must succeed a Dexterity saving throw against your move DC in order to use movement. All attack rolls against you are done with disadvantage, and yoou have advantage on saving throws while the distortion zone is active.

Cosmic.name: Reality Shift
Cosmic.description:
You attempt to manipulate the nature of ether energy in a target. Unless the target is willing, it must succeed a Wisdom saving throw against your move DC or become a random type for 1d4 turns, until the end of its last turn with the effect.
Roll a d20:
1: Bug
2: Dark
3: Dragon
4: Electric:
5: Fairy
6: Fighting
7: Fire
8: Flying
9: Ghost
10: Grass
11: Ground
12: Ice
13: Normal
14: Poison
15: Psychic
16: Rock
17: Steel
18: Water
19: Cosmic
20: Your choice

Cosmic.name: Recover
Cosmic.description: You reverse time to close wounds and recover the hit points of a creature in range. The target regains 1d6 + MOVE hit points.
Cosmic.scaling: The dice roll for healing increases to 2d6 at level 5, 4d6 at level 10, and 6d6 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Roar of Time
Cosmic.description: You unleash a roar that has the power to distort time. All creatures within range must make a WIS save against your Move DC, taking 10d12 + MOVE cosmic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. For any creature that failed the save by 5 or more, you may immediately take another action against them. Roar of Time may not be used as one of the additional actions. This move may be used once per long rest.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Spacial Rend
Cosmic.description: You release a powerful shockwave that tears through creatures and the space around them. All creatures within range must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 10d12 + MOVE cosmic damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail this save by 5 or more become uncontrollable and are sucked into the Ethereal Plane until the beginning of your next turn, appearing in the same location when they return, suffering the Blink effect for 1 minute. This move may be usedd once per long rest.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Star Drain
Cosmic.description: You absorb all light in an 80ft. radius. All creatures dependent on sight in the area are considered blind for the next round. On your next turn, you release a bright flash of cosmic energy in an 60ft. cone. All creatures hit must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or suffer 4d12 + MOVE cosmic damage and be blinded for 1 minute. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not blinded. The lighting in the area returns to normal after the release of energy.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Starfall
Cosmic.description:
You call down a barrage of stellar energy in a 15ft. radius, 100ft. tall cylinder, centered on a point within range. All creatures within the area must succeed a Strength saving throw against your move DC, or take 10d12 + MOVE cosmic damage and be knocked prone. Creatures that fail the save are also blinded until the end of their next turn from the brilliant light. Creatures within 60ft of the impact (but outside the radius) must make a CON save or be blinded for 1 round. On a success, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. Flying or otherwise ungrounded creatures must make an additional Constitution saving throw with the same DC, falling to the ground on a failed save. The blast ignores shields and barriers, and will not be hindered by moves like Protect, though such moves may be used to gain advantage on the saving throw. The impact creates a 15ft radius crater. The area becomes difficult terrain and is 10ft lower than the surrounding ground. Creatures in the crater have disadvantage on ranged attacks against creatures outside it.
This move may be used once per long rest.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Temporal Fang
Cosmic.description: You bite down with temporal force. Make an attack roll against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE cosmic damage on a hit. The hit creature must succeed a Wisdom saving throw or be slowed for 1d4 rounds, moving at half speed and having disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws. Creatures attacking a slowed target have advantage on their attack rolls.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Cosmic.name: Temporal Shift
Cosmic.description: You briefly alter the flow of time. Choose one creature within 60 feet. If the target is willing, it can immediately take an extra action. If it's unwilling, it must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or lose its next action.

Cosmic.name: Void Gate
Cosmic.description:
You momentarily tear open a rift in space that creates a portal that lasts for 1 + MOVE rounds. First roll 1d4 to determine rift size. Then roll a d100, with the outcome determining where the portal leads. Attempting to open a gateway to a specific location affects possible outcomes. The GM will provide you the necessary information after this.
This move can only be used once per long rest.

Cosmic.name: Void Strike
Cosmic.description: You lash out, striking an opponent with a surge of cosmic energy. Make a ranged attack roll against a target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE cosmic damage on a hit.
Cosmic.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: 10. Death Ray
Dark.description: If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d12 MOVE + Dark damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, it dies.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17

Dark.name: 3. Fear Ray
Dark.description: The targeted creature must succeed on a  Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Dark.name: Abyssal Eye
Dark.description: You stare deeply into the eyes of a creature in range, allowing them to see the darkness within you. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage. On a roll of 15 or higher, the target flinches.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Abyssal Grasp
Dark.description: After landing a melee attack, you may use a bonus action to activate this move. Ethereal tentacles from the abyss wrap around the creature, attempting to restrain it. Make a melee attack roll, restraining the creature on a success. On its turn, the creature may attempt to break free by attempting a STR save against your move DC.

Dark.name: Abyssal Surge
Dark.description: You create a massive wave of dark water in a 60-foot cone. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity saving throw, taking 10d12 dark damage and 4d8 water damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Additionally, creatures that fail the save are pushed 30 feet away and knocked prone.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Dark.name: Al Dente
Dark.description: You attempt to sink your terrifying set of teeth into a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. On a roll of 15 or higher, the creature is frightened. If this attack hits an already frightened creature, double the damage dice for this move.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Assurance
Dark.description: You strike an opponent where it already hurts. Make a melee attack against an opponent, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the target has already taken damage in the same round, double the damage dice.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Aura Theft
Dark.description: The user attempts to steal beneficial effects from a target within 30 feet. The target must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or lose all beneficial effects currently affecting it. The user gains the effects of one of these spells or effects (user's choice) for the remainder of their duration.

Dark.name: Beat Up
Dark.description: You exploit a creature's vulnerable position. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d6 + MOVE dark damage on hit. Add 1d6 for each allied creature adjacent to the target (max +4d6). If the target is completely surrounded (no empty adjacent squares), it has disadvantage on its next attack.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Bite
Dark.description: You sink your teeth into an enemy Pokémon. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE dark damage on a successful hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target flinches.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Black Hole
Dark.description:
This move can only be activated after surviving Supernova. As a bonus action, an area in a 100ft square centered on you becomes shrouded in complete darkness for 1 minute.
Creatures outside the sphere can't see or hear what's happening inside unless they have truesight. Creatures within the sphere are blind and deaf while inside.
Creatures that start their turn inside the sphere take 2d8 + MOVE dark damage (no save). A creature inside the sphere must use its action to attempt to escape, making a WIS save against your Move DC. On success, it finds the edge and may use any remaining movement to exit. On failure, it moves in a random direction.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Brutal Swing
Dark.description: You swing your arms around violently, attacking anything within a 5 foot circle, centered on yourself. All creatures in range must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE dark damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Crunch
Dark.description: You unleash a powerful blow that has a chance to temporarily lower a target’s defense. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or higher, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 for the remainder of combat. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to AC.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Dark Pulse
Dark.description: You target an opponent with a dark aura filled with horrible thoughts. Make a ranged attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 17 or higher, the target flinches.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Dark Void
Dark.description:
You send the minds of your opponents into a
world of darkness, putting them to sleep. All creatures
within 30 feet of you must make a WIS save against your
Move DC, falling asleep on a failure.

Dark.name: Embargo
Dark.description: You surround a creature in range with a dark aura. Force a creature to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target cannot gain the effect of any held item or trainer item given to it for the duration.

Dark.name: Fake Tears
Dark.description: You fake a creature out with superficial tears, lowering their defenses. When activating this move, a target must make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.

Dark.name: Feint Attack
Dark.description: You bring a creature close and hit it with a sucker punch. Make a melee attack on a creature, always with advantage, doing 1d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Flatter
Dark.description: You send mixed signals to a creature. Select a target in range. They become confused, but during this confusion, they double their proficiency bonus when making attack rolls.

Dark.name: Fling
Dark.description: Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d6 + MOVE dark damage on hit. The item is consumed. The GM may rule additional effects based on the item thrown.

Dark.name: Foul Play
Dark.description: You turn a creature's own power against it. Make a melee attack roll using your MOVE power. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + MOVE dark damage using their own MOVE power.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Hone Claws
Dark.description: You sharpen your claws to increase the power of your attacks. For the duration, add an additional +1 to your attack and damage rolls. This move may be stacked to a maximum of +3 to attack and damage rolls.

Dark.name: Hyperspace Fury
Dark.description: You send a barrage of three balls of furious energy at any creature(s) in range. Each ball automatically deals 3d10 dark damage to any creature(s) you choose. Reactions that negate damage such as Protect or Detect cannot be used, and creatures in the invulnerable stages of moves like Fly, Dig, etc. can be targeted by thiis move. After activating this move, any attacks against you, until the beginning of your next turn, are rolled at advantage. This move may be used once per short rest.
Dark.scaling: You can fire 4 projectiles at level 5, 5 projectiles at level 10, and 6 projectiles at level 17.

Dark.name: Imperial Decree
Dark.description: A hostile creature within range is forced to succeed a Charisma saving throw, or be charmed by you for 1 hour. The charmed creature considers you their closest friend and ally for the duration, and will do everything in its power to not harm you, and to further your goals. It still maintains loyalty towards others, turning hostile towards friends only if they threaten you. The charm will be broken if you inflict damage on the charmed creature, or if you lose concentration.
Dark.scaling: The number of creatures you can affect with this move increases to 3 at level 5, 5 at level 10, and 10 at level 17.

Dark.name: Knock Off
Dark.description: You attempt to rid a creature of their held item for the rest of battle. Make a melee attack roll against a target. On a hit, deal 1d10 + MOVE dark damage and any held item of the target falls to the ground somewhere in the vicinity.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Memento
Dark.description:
You sacrifice your life force to leave a lasting
mark on a target. When you activate this move, you touch a
creature and drop to 0 hit points. As a result, the target is
incapacitated for 2 rounds. All attacks against it have
advantage, it automatically fails all STR and DEX saving
throws, and it cannot attack, move, flee, or be switched out.

Dark.name: Murky Gaze
Dark.description: Your eyes light up with an eerie glow to attract the attention of all creatures within 50ft. that can see your eyes. Choose a direction to be facing. Make a Wisdom or Charisma roll. All affected creatures that can see your eyes must succeed a WIS saving throw against your roll, or become focused on you for the duration. While focused, a creature has disadvantage on perception checks to detect other creatures, and is placed at the bottom of the initiative order. While focused, a creature can't move further away from you than 50ft.

Dark.name: Nasty Plot
Dark.description: You stimulate your brain with nasty thoughts. For the duration, you have advantage on any attacks with the Wisdom move power. If the attack requires a Wisdom saving throw, the target has disadvantage.

Dark.name: Night Daze
Dark.description: A pitch black shockwave of dark energy rushes towards a target. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 13 or more, the target rolls its next attack with disadvantage. If it activates a move that requires a saving throw, the target(s) have advantage on the roll.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Night Slash
Dark.description: You slash out at a creature with dark power. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. This attack scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 19 or 20.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Omen Sense
Dark.description: You become highly alert, sensing incoming attacks and getting ready to respond to them. For one round, opponents have disadvantage on attack rolls against you. Upon being hit, you may use your reaction to retaliate with an attacking move against your attacker. The retaliation will be resovled simultaneously, meaning you still do damage even if you faint from the hit. This move may be used once per short rest.

Dark.name: Parting Shot
Dark.description: You deliver a brutal parting threat. Force a creature in range to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, the targets nervousness causes it to deal half damage when using a damaging moves for one minute. They may use their action to attempt to overcome their nervousness by making a WIS saving throw against your move DC. You may then move up to 30ft without provoking opportunity attacks and take a free Hide action, or switch out.

Dark.name: Payback
Dark.description: You strike hard in retaliation. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d6 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the target damaged you earlier this round, double the dice roll for the damage of this attack.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Power Trip
Dark.description: You boast your strength and attack a target. Make a melee attack, doing 1d4 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. For each positive stat change affecting the user, add an additional damage dice (Focus Energy, Harden, etc.).
Dark.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Dark.name: Punishment
Dark.description: You send dark energy to punish a creature. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the target is currently under the influence of a move or ability that boosts its attack, damage, or AC, increase the damage by 1d10 for each effect.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Pursuit
Dark.description: As a reaction, when a creature moves away from you or is switched out by their trainer, you may make a ranged attack roll against it, doing 1d6 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the creature is fleeing combat or being switched out, double the damage dice.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Quash
Dark.description: You send dark energy at a creature in range, reducing their will to fight. The target must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, it must move to the bottom of the initiative order for this round only. Targets that have already taken their turn in this round are unaffected.

Dark.name: Snarl
Dark.description: You release a harsh growl at a creature, damaging their willpower. Force a creature to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target takes 1d10 + MOVE dark damage. If you are the target of its next attack, the attack is rolled at disadvantage.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Snatch
Dark.description: You call upon dark energy to steal an effect from a creature. When a creature in range activates a move with a positive effect on itself (curing negative status effect, boosting stats, healing, etc.), force it to make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a failure, you gain the positive effect and the target's move fails.

Dark.name: Stellar Negation
Dark.description: When a Cosmic type move is activated within range, you may nullify all non-damaging effects from this and other Cosmic moves activated within range for one round, and for the duration count Cosmic type damage as Normal damage.

Dark.name: Sucker Punch
Dark.description: You lay in a quick punch before a creature has a chance to attack. When targeted by a melee attack, you may use your reaction to attempt to strike a creature before its attack is rolled. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Switcheroo
Dark.description: Your hands move with incredible speed as you attempt to switch held items with a creature. Force a creature to make a DEX save against your Move DC. On a failure, you take their held item and replace it with your own. If you do not have a held item, you simply take theirs without replacement.

Dark.name: Taunt
Dark.description: You taunt a creature to only attack you with damaging attacks. Choose a target in range and force it to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the target can only use damaging attacks that target you for the duration.

Dark.name: Thief
Dark.description: You lash out with a quick attack that may steal a creature’s held item. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. If the user does not have an item held, the target must make a DEX save against your Move DC or have their item stolen by the user.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Throat Chop
Dark.description: You focus in on an attack at the target’s throat. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit. On hit, the target is unable to activate sound based attacks for its next 1d4 turns.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dark.name: Topsy-Turvy
Dark.description: You unleash a dark energy that has the power to reverse the stat changes of a creature. Force a creature in range to make a CHA save against your Move DC. On a failure, any stat changes (-1 to attack, +2 to AC, etc.) currently affecting the target have the opposite effect.

Dark.name: Torment
Dark.description: You send a dark energy to torment a creature in range that attacks you. When hit by a melee or ranged attack, force the target to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the target cannot use the same move that hit you on its next turn.

Dark.name: Twilight Rush
Dark.description: You go all out in a flurry of dark strikes, sacrificing your defenses. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 3d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit, rolled with advantage. After activating this move, your AC is reduced by 1d4, and the target has advantage on any attack it makes against you, until the beginning of your next turn.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Void Consumption
Dark.description: Requires Reality Bend to be active. You attempt to pull in creatures in a 60ft. cone in front of you. All creatures within range must make a Wisdom saving throw with disadvantage, taking 3d10 + MOVE dark damage on a hit as well as being pulled 15ft. towards you. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not pulled towards you. Creatures that come within yoour melee range as a result of being pulled in, take double damage. You heal for half of all damage dealt.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Dark.name: Void Eruption
Dark.description: You focus a surge of darkness to overpower your opponent. A rift in reality opens up beneath a creature in range, erupting with dark force. The creature must succeed a DEX saving throw, taking 4d12 + MOVE dark damage and 3d10 cosmic damage on a failure, half as much on a success. Large or smaller creatures must then succeed a Strength save or be flung up to 30 feet, landing prone. Protect or similar moves will not negate this move, but will reduce damage by half and automatically succeed the saving throw.
Dark.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17

Dragon.name: Draco Meteor
Dragon.description: You summon forth a meteor shower that rains down on your opponents. Choose 3 points within range. Each point has a 10ft radius impact. The points can't be the same, but the impact zones can overlap. All creatures in the impact zones must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE dragon damage on a hit, or half as much on a save. If a creature is in multiple impact zones, it makes a saving throw for each zone. After activating this move, your next attack is rolled at disadvantage. If that attack requires a saving throw, the target has advantage. This move may be used once per short rest.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dragon Breath
Dragon.description: You release a powerful breath of energy in a 40 foot cone. All targets caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE dragon damage on a fail, and half as much on a save. If an opponent fails the save by 5 or more, it is paralyzed.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dragon Claw
Dragon.description: You strike out with a powerful claw attack. Make a melee attack on an opponent, doing 1d10 + MOVE dragon damage on a hit.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dragon Dance
Dragon.description:
You perform a mystical dance, pumping yourself
up. For the duration, double your proficiency bonus when
making an attack.

Dragon.name: Dragon Pulse
Dragon.description: You open your mouth and send a shockwave of draconic energy at a target in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dragon damage on a hit.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dragon Rage
Dragon.description: You unleash a devastating flow of energy in a 100 foot long line, 5 feet wide. Each creature caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE dragon damage on a fail, and half as much on a save.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dragon Rush
Dragon.description: You rush at an opponent with overwhelming menace. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dragon damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 17 or higher, the target flinches.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dragon Tail
Dragon.description: You whip your dragon tail at an opponent in an attempt to send them away. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dragon damage and forcing it to make a CON save against your Move DC on a hit. On a failure, the target is too frightened by you to remain in battle. In trainer battles, the target must be switched out if another creature is available. In wild battles, the target must move up to half its speed away from the user, but only attempts to flee outright if it a lower level than the user.
Dragon.scaling: This damage dice for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 3d6 at level 10, and 4d8 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Dual Chop
Dragon.description: You lash out at an opponent(s) with two quick strikes. Make two melee attack rolls, dealing 1d6 + MOVE dragon damage with each hit.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Hydra Bite
Dragon.description: You lash out at opponents in range with a vicious bite. You may attack a number of times equal to the number of heads you have, costing 3VP per attack. Make melee attack rolls for all attacks, dealing 1d10 + MOVE dragon damage with each hit. You may target the same creature multiple times.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Hydra Strike
Dragon.description: This move can only be used three times per combat. You engage multiple heads in combat at once, each attacking with a move. You gain two + 1d2 move actions to be resolved immediately. You cannot activate this move more than once per round. You may not use Hydra Bite the same round that this move is activated.
Dragon.scaling: The extra move action dice becomes 1d3 at level 16, and 1d4 at level 18.

Dragon.name: Outrage
Dragon.description: You go into a rampage, doing several attacks without control for three rounds. This move automatically hits for 2d8 + MOVE dragon damage in the first round, 4d8 + MOVE dragon damage in the second round, and 8d8 + MOVE dragon damage in the third round. When this move ends, either after the third round or from breaking concentration, you become confused. This attack stops if concentration is broken, or the user becomes incapacitated.
Dragon.scaling: The dice used for this move changes to a d10 at level 5, a d12 at level 10, and a d20 at level 17.

Dragon.name: Thunderous Roar
Dragon.description: The user lets out a mighty roar. All creatures within 60 feet must make a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Dragon.name: Twister
Dragon.description: You send a gust of swirling wind that tears through a creature. Make a ranged attack on a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE dragon damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 16 or higher, the target flinches.
Dragon.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: 2. Stun Ray
Electric.description: The targeted creature must succeed on a  Constitution saving throw or be stunned for 1 minute. The target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Electric.name: Bolt Strike
Electric.description: You send down a powerful strike of lightning from the heavens, surrounding an area of the battlefield with surging electricity. Any opponent caught in a 20 foot radius, centered on a point within range, must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE electric damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by more than 5, it becomes paralyzed. This move can be used once per long rest.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Electric.name: Charge
Electric.description:
Electricity surges through your body, charging
up for your next attack. Until your next turn, boost your AC
by 2. On your next turn, double your STAB bonus when
dealing damage of your type.

Electric.name: Charge Beam
Electric.description: You send a beam of electric energy at an opponent that has a chance to power you up. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d6 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 10 or higher and the attack hits, add your proficiency bonus to the damage.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Cyclone Charge
Electric.description:
You generate a cyclone charged with lightning in a 30 foot radius around yourself. All creatures in range must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking half damage on a success and full damage on a fail. Creatures in range that are not grounded or in the invulnerable stage of Fly or Bounce take double damage from this move. Roll a d6 on the table below to determine damage.
1: 2d6+MOVE
2-3: 3d6+MOVE
4-5: 4d6+MOVE
6: 5d6+MOVE
Electric.scaling: For damage rolls, use 2x Dice at level 5, 4x Dice at level 10, and 8x Dice at level 17.

Electric.name: Discharge
Electric.description: You let loose a flare of electricity in a 10 foot radius, centered on you, striking all creatures around you. Creatures in the area must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC. On a fail, a creature takes 2d8 + MOVE electric damage. If a creature fails the save by more than 5, it is paralyzed. This move can be used once per short rest.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Eerie Impulse
Electric.description: Your body generates a strange pulsating sound that can disrupt the target's ability to attack. When you activate this move, any hostile creature within 30 feet of you must make a CON saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the target flinches for 1d4 rounds.

Electric.name: Electric Terrain
Electric.description: You electrify the ground around you to create a static field of electricity. For 3 turns, no grounded creatures inside the area can be asleep. In addition, creatures may double their MOVE modifier on damage rolls from electric-type moves activated inside the area

Electric.name: Electrify
Electric.description: You suddenly surge with a strange electric energy signature that transfers to your attacker. When hit by a melee attack, you may instantly use your reaction to force the attacker to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the attacking move's type is changed to electric.

Electric.name: Electro Ball
Electric.description: You hurl an electric orb at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. Compare the target and user's highest speed type (walking, flying, etc.). If the user's speed is higher, roll the next level tier's damage dice for this move. If the user is level 17 or higher, double the damage dice.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Electroweb
Electric.description: You unleash an electric net of web upon a creature. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE electric damage on a hit, and reducing the target's speed by 5 feet. The target can use an action on its turn remove any web from its body. A target whose speed is reduced to 0 is restrained.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Energize
Electric.description: You create a field of static energy in a 15 foot radius around you, draining the vitality from nearby creatures. Force all creatures in range to attempt a CON save, losing 2d8 VP on a failure and half of that on a success. Regain half of the total amount of VP drained.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Ether Bolt
Electric.description: You shoot a stream of pure electrical ether energy towards a creature in range. Force one creature to make a DEX save, taking 2d8 + MOVE electric damage and being paralyzed on a failure, half as much without being paralyzed on a success.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Etheric Discharge
Electric.description: When hit by a melee attack, you may use this reaction to zap your attacker, forcing it to attempt a DEX save. On a failure, the VP cost is multiplied by 1d4.

Electric.name: Fusion Bolt
Electric.description: You summon a gigantic lightning bolt that strikes down from the heavens in a 30 foot radius, centered on a point within range. All creatures caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE electric damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If Fusion Bolt or Fusion Flare was already used this round, double the damage dealt.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Electric.name: Ion Deluge
Electric.description: You disperse electric particles that charge the battlefield. Until the beginning of your next turn, any normal-type move activated within 50 feet of you is considered electric-type.

Electric.name: Magnet Rise
Electric.description:
You use magnetic power within yourself to raise
yourself from the ground, becoming immune to ground
moves for the duration.

Electric.name: Magnetic Flux
Electric.description:
You use your electric energy to manipulate
magnetic fields. Until the beginning of your next turn, any
creature in range with the Plus or Minus ability gains a
bonus to their AC equal to your proficiency modifier, and
any saving throw they are forced to make is rolled with
advantage.

Electric.name: Magnetic Pulse
Electric.description: The user emits a pulse of magnetic energy. Each creature that is steel type, wearing metal armor or holding a metal weapon within 30 feet must succeed on a Strength saving throw or either be pulled 15 feet toward the user, or pushed 15 feet away.
Electric.scaling: Starting from level 10, the user may choose to knock creatures that fail the saving throw prone instead of pushing or pulliing them.

Electric.name: Nuzzle
Electric.description: You touch a creature with your electrified cheeks, sending electricity coursing through their veins. Make an attack roll against a creature. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + MOVE electric damage and is forced to make a CON save against your Move DC, becoming paralyzed on a failure.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Parabolic Charge
Electric.description: A sweeping electric charge arcs around you, stealing some of the target's energy. Force all creatures in a 15ft radius, centered on you, to make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE electric damage on a failure. Recover hit points equal to half the total damage dealt, but no more than 5 times your level.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Shock Wave
Electric.description: A burst of electric energy glides forward, striking anything in a 15 foot cone. This move is guaranteed to hit all creatures caught in the wave for 1d4 + MOVE electric damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Electric.name: Spark
Electric.description: You strike out with an electrified tackle with a chance to paralyze a target. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target is paralyzed.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Static Shield
Electric.description: You may use this reaction when a creature lands an attack against you, and has rolled for damage. You supercharge parts of your body, creating a force field that reflects incoming attacks. You take no damage from the triggering attack. Make an attack roll, dealing half of the damage that you would have sustained on a hit as electric damage. Of the attack you're reflecting is ranged, you roll with disadvantage. On a natural roll of 15 or higher, the opponent is paralyzed. A natural 20 will guarantee a hit, but will not be a critical hit.

Electric.name: Storm Surge
Electric.description: You create strong winds that hurl electrified water droplets at an incredible speed in an 80ft. line, 5 feet wide. Announce if you intend to to electric or water damage. All creatures caught in the line is forced to make a DEX save against your move DC, taking 2d8 MOVE + electric OR water damage on a failure. This move can only be used while it is raining.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Thunder
Electric.description: Powerful electric energy arcs out from you, hitting any creature in a 20 foot radius, centered on you. Creatures caught in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE electric damage on a fail, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the saving throw by 5 or more become paralyzed. In heavy rain or storms, you may center this move on a point within 60ft instead of on yourself.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Thunder Fang
Electric.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with electric fangs. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed and flinches.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Thunder Punch
Electric.description: Your punches are imbued with electric energy. Make a melee attack on a target, doing 2d8 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Thunder Shock
Electric.description: You deliver an electric shock to a target in range. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE electric damage on a hit.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Electric.name: Thunder Wave
Electric.description: You send a wave of electric energy that surrounds a creature in range. The target must make a CON save against your Move DC or become paralyzed.

Electric.name: Thunderbolt
Electric.description: You send a powerful bolt of electricity at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is paralyzed.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Thunderstorm Dance
Electric.description: You perform a lightning fast dance, ionizing your body. For as long as you maintain concentration, all electric type moves are guaranteed to hit.

Electric.name: Volt Switch
Electric.description: You lash out with a quick, electric strike before you make a getaway. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. After this move is activated, if it is possible, you must either move up to half your movement speed away from your target, not provoking opportunity attacks, or your trainer must switch you out as a free action.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Volt Tackle
Electric.description: You rush forward in a flash of electricity with extended reach, slamming into a creature. When activating this move, you flash forward 15 feet and make a melee attack roll against a creature, dealing 2d8 + Move electric damage on a hit. On a hit, you also take a quarter of the total (rounded down) in typeless recoil damage.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Wild Charge
Electric.description: You shroud yourself in electricity and charge at a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE electric damage on a hit, but taking 1/4 of the damage (rounded down) in recoil damage.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Zap Cannon
Electric.description: You fire out an extreme blast of pure electric energy at a creature. Make a ranged attack against a target in range, doing 3d10 + MOVE electric damage. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target is paralyzed.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Electric.name: Zing Zap
Electric.description: A strong electric blast crashes down on two unique targets in range, giving them electric shock. Make two ranged attacks, dealing 3d10 + MOVE electric damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or higher, the target flinches.
Electric.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: 1. Charm Ray
Fairy.description: The targeted creature must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed by the beholder for 1 hour, or until the beholder harms the creature.

Fairy.name: 9. Disintegration Ray
Fairy.description: You emit a thin, extremely high energy beam at a target. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or take 4d12 MOVE + Fairy damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 hit points, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Aromatic Mist
Fairy.description:
You release an aroma that inspires your allies.
When you activate this move, you and any ally within 5 feet
of you may add a d4 to any saving throw they make for the
duration.
Fairy.scaling:
The bonus dice roll for this move changes to a
1d6 at level 10.

Fairy.name: Artifact Light
Fairy.description: You channel energy from ancient artifacts to enhance your combat prowess. If an ancient artifact is within range and you know it is there, add double your proficiency bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Fairy.name: Baby-Doll Eyes
Fairy.description:
You quickly widen your eyes in an attempt to
charm an opponent, decreasing their will to fight. When you
or an ally in range are targeted by a Move that requires an
attack roll, you may use a reaction to impose disadvantage
on the roll.

Fairy.name: Charm
Fairy.description: You attempt to charm an opponent, sharply decreasing its attack. A target you choose in range must make a WIS save against your Move DC. On a fail, the target adds -2 to all attacks against you for the duration.
Fairy.scaling:
The target adds -3 at level 5, -4 at level 10, and
-5 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Charm Person
Fairy.description: You attempt to charm a humanoid you can see within range. It must make a Wisdom saving throw, and does so with advantage if you or your companions are fighting it. If it fails the saving throw, it is charmed by you until the spell ends or until you or your companions do anything harmful to it. The charmed creature regards you as a friendly acquaintance. When the spell ends, the creature knows it was charmed by you.
Fairy.scaling: At level 10, you may expend 10 additional VP to charm one more target, with another optional target being unlocked at level 15.

Fairy.name: Courtly Grace
Fairy.description: You impart knowledge of proper conduct and posture to allies within range. For the duration, attack rolls made against you or your allies have -1 modifier. This effect will not stack.
Fairy.scaling: The negative modifier for attack rolls changes to -2 at level 5, -3 at level 10 and -5 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Crafty Shield
Fairy.description:
You summon forth a mysterious power that
blocks an incoming status condition. When you or an ally
within 5 feet of you are subject to a status condition from an
enemy move, you may use your reaction to nullify the
condition.

Fairy.name: Dawn Burst
Fairy.description:
You may only use while your current hit points are above 75% of your maximum. Your form transforms into pure ether for an instant as you let out a massive burst of energy. All creatures in a 60ft. radius must succeed a Charisma saving throw, or take 4d12 + MOVE damage of any type, and be stunned for one round. The type of damage is determined by you. This move does not benefit from STAB even if your type aligns with the type of damage dealt. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not stunned.
This move costs VP equal to your current HP. After using this move, you drop to 1 hit point and are not able to use attack moves or be recalled until the end of your next turn. This move may be used once per long rest.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Dazzling Gleam
Fairy.description: You emit a powerful flash that damages all creatures in range. Creatures within 20 feet of you must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE fairy damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Dazzling Lights
Fairy.description: The user creates a dazzling display of lights. All creatures within a 30-foot cone must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be blinded until the end of the user's next turn.

Fairy.name: Dimension Dance
Fairy.description: You do a strange dance that allows you to phase in and out of existence. For the duration, all attacks against you are rolled with disadvantage.

Fairy.name: Disarming Voice
Fairy.description:
You let out a charming cry, dealing emotional
damage to any opponent in range that can hear you. This
move automatically hits for 1d4 + MOVE fairy damage
unless a creature is in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Dig,
Bounce, etc.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Divine Noodle Form
Fairy.description: Your noodly appendages multiply, and your body grows to a huge size. While in this form, you gain the ability Spaghedeity; you get half of your current max HP as temporary bonus HP, and your melee reach is increased to 15ft.

Fairy.name: Draining Kiss
Fairy.description: You attempt to zap the target's energy with a kiss. Make a melee attack roll on an opponent, dealing 1d6 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit. The user is then healed for half the damage dealt.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Dream Mend
Fairy.description: You touch a sleeping creature, causing their sleep to rapidly restore their health for 3d10 + MOVE. The creature wakes up at the end of their next turn, fully refreshed.

Fairy.name: Fairy Lock
Fairy.description:
You summon forth a mystical power that locks down the battlefield. Creatures within a 40 foot circle,
centered on you, may not flee or be switched out on their next turn.
Fairy.scaling: The range of this move changes to 50ft. at level 5, 60ft. at level 10, and 80ft. at level 17.

Fairy.name: Fairy Scales
Fairy.description: You release a cloud of shimmering scales in a 15ft. cone. All affected creatures must succeed a DEX saving throw or have disadvantage on their attack rolls until the end of their next turn.

Fairy.name: Fairy Wind
Fairy.description:
You stir up a series of vicious fairy winds that fly towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll
against a target, dealing 1d6 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Flavor Savor
Fairy.description: You smell the aroma of a creature within melee range, sending you into a ravenous frenzy. Make a melee attack, grappling and restraining the creature on a hit. On your next turn, if you kept your concentration, you swallow the creature whole. While inside you, the creature is incapacitated. If you faint, you regurgitate all swallowed creatures from this encounter. This move only works on creatures smaller than you.

Fairy.name: Fleur Cannon
Fairy.description: You unleash a beam of energy in a 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures in its path must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fairy damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures failing the save by 5 or more are blinded until the end of their next turn. After activating this move, your next attack is rolled at disadvantage. If the next attack requires a saving throw, the target(s) gain advantage.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Floral Healing
Fairy.description: You extend a healing energy to recover the hit points of a creature in range. The target gains 2d8 + MOVE hit points. If the terrain is grassy, double your MOVE modifier.
