Fairy.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 10, and 4d12 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Flower Shield
Fairy.description: Large flowers sprout from any grass-type allies in range, boosting their defense. For one minute, as long as you keep your concentration, grass-type allies in a 15 foot circle, centered on you, gain +2 to their AC.

Fairy.name: Forest Guardian
Fairy.description: You lash out with the power of the forest. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or higher, all of your ability scores go up by 1 while you remain in battle. This move can be stacked for a maximum of +5 to all ability scores.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Fortune Ring
Fairy.description: You create a magical ring on the ground that encircles a 15ft. radius. For the duration, the DC for critical hits is lowered by 1 for any move activated within the circle.
Fairy.scaling: The DC is lowered by 2 at level 10, and 3 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Geomancy
Fairy.description: You spend time to absorb the natural energy around you, sharply increasing your effect in battle. When you activate this move, your speed increases by 10 feet and all of your attacks and saving throws are rolled with advantage for three rounds.

Fairy.name: Golden Touch
Fairy.description: You turn your held item into gold, increasing its value but otherwise making it unusable in battle. The value of your item is up to the DM's discretion.

Fairy.name: Harmony Breath
Fairy.description: You exhale a cone of shimmering energy that damages enemies and heals allies. All affected hostile creatures must succeed a WIS saving throw or take 3d10 + MOVE fairy damage. Allied creatures caught in the blast heal for half the amount rolled + MOVE.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Light Dance
Fairy.description: You conjure illusory duplicates of yourself made of a mystical light, confusing attackers. For the next three rounds, gain +2 AC.

Fairy.name: Light of Ruin
Fairy.description: You draw forth a powerful natural essence, concentrating it into a beam of light 80ft long and 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must make DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE fairy damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The user takes recoil damage equal to half the damage rolled.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Light Spike
Fairy.description:
You hurl glowing spikes at up to three targets in range. Make three ranged attacks, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit. On a hit, the target needs to make a Constitution saving throw, or become drowsy for 1d4 minutes. While drowsy, the creature suffers disadvantage on saving throws and attack rolls, and other creatures have advantage on saving throws induced by this Pokémon.
At the end of the drowsiness, the creature falls unconscious for 1d12 hours. For the duration, the creature can't be awakened by normal means unless it completes a long rest. They are, however, considered asleep, and can be damaged by Bad Dreams, Dream Eater or similar moves.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Luminous Veil
Fairy.description:
When you are the target of an attack, you may use your reaction to emit a mesmerizing light pattern in a 30ft. radius. All creatures in range must make a Wisdom saving throw, suffering disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the beginning of your next turn.
Then, roll a d10. On a 9 or 10, you regain your reaction.
Fairy.scaling: At level 10, the range increases to 50ft.

Fairy.name: Marinara Mist
Fairy.description: A sinister, yet weirdly tangy, marinara mist descends on a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, gaining temporary control of the creature's senses on a hit. At the start of the creature's turn, you announce how you confuse its senses and how it responds. The red mist dissipates after 1 minute, or if the affected creature is healed of all status conditions by any means.

Fairy.name: Mesmerizing Dance
Fairy.description: The user performs a captivating dance. All creatures within 30 feet that can see the user must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. While charmed, the creature's speed is zero. The creature can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Fairy.name: Misty Terrain
Fairy.description: You cover the ground in a thin, healing mist that surrounds a 60 foot circle, centered on you. For 3 turns, no grounded creatures inside the mist can suffer from new status conditions. Grounded creatures are those that do not have a flying speed or Levitate, Magnet Rise, or similar ability.

Fairy.name: Moonblast
Fairy.description: You summon forth a powerful moonbeam that strikes a creature. Make a ranged attack on a target in range, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or more, the target has disadvantage on its next attack.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Moonlight
Fairy.description: A ray of moonlight shines upon you, basking you in healing light. The user gains 2d6 + MOVE hit points.
Fairy.scaling: The dice roll for healing changes to 3d6 at level 5, 5d6 at level 10, and 8d6 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Moonlight Waltz
Fairy.description: You grab a creature and attempt a mystical waltz that drains its vitality. Make a melee attack, grappling and restraining the creature on a hit. The target must then succeed a WIS saving throw or become charmed by you. For three turns, or until you lose concentration, you are locked in a dance that as your action drains the target of 2d8 VP each turn. You regain half of the VP drained as HP. The target may use its action to attempt to breakk free from yuor grapple on its turn, unless it is charmed. You may use your action to stop dancing on your turn. After the dance ends, the charm persists until it is broken.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Moonlit Mirage
Fairy.description: An eerie glow surrounds you, creating illusory copies of yourself. For the duration, all attack rolls against you are rolled with disadvantage.

Fairy.name: Nature's Madness
Fairy.description: You harness all the power of nature and send it at a creature in range. The target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failed save, the target loses half their current HP (minimum of 1 damage). This move consumes VP equal to the HP lost by the target.

Fairy.name: Noodly Appendage
Fairy.description: After landing an attack, you may extend your noodly appendage to touch the creature hit as a bonus action. The creature is forced to make a WIS save against your move power on a hit, becoming confused and charmed if the save fails. On a fumble, the creature is stunned.
Fairy.scaling: From level 18, if the creature fumbles the saving throw, it is petrified.

Fairy.name: Pasta Portal
Fairy.description: You disappear from view and reappear at an unoccupied point within range, having opened a portal between the two spots. In wild creature battles, this move can be activated to automatically count as a single success in a group DEX check to run away. The portal lingers for 3 turns. Any creature except you attempting to pass through the portal must succeed a DEX save, or be subjected to the move Crunch. Only one pair of portals may be active at any time.

Fairy.name: Photon Pulse
Fairy.description: You send a burst of light energy at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 17 or higher, the target is blinded until the end of its next turn.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Play Rough
Fairy.description: You fake a creature out with a playful attack that quickly becomes too rough. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fairy damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 19 or 20, the target adds -1 to any attack it makes for the remainder of combat. This effect can be stacked to a maximum of -5 to hit.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Radiant Hope
Fairy.description: You channel the energy of the morning sun to heal your allies. Each ally within range regains hp equal to 4d12 + MOVE. They also gain advantage on their next attack roll. Using this move strains the user, damaging it by the same amount it heals others. This move may only be used once per day, recharging at dawn.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Relic Song
Fairy.description: You sing an ancient song that damages creatures in range with the chance to put them asleep. Any creature in a 20ft circle, centered on you, must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fairy damage on a failure, or half as much ona success. Any creature that fails the save by 5 or more is put to sleep.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Song of the Deep
Fairy.description: You sing a hauntingly beautiful song that can be heard in a 5 mile radius. Affected creatures have to make a save against your move DC, their minds being captured by you on a failure. You then fall asleep, entering the Dreamscape with your captives.

Fairy.name: Sweet Kiss
Fairy.description: You lay a kiss on a creature, attempting to confuse them. The target must make an CHA saving throw against your Move DC or become confused.

Fairy.name: Tragic Hero
Fairy.description: You grant a divine second wind to a willing creature in range that has just fallen to less than one third of its maximum HP, rounded down. The creature is granted a new turn immediately after this reaction. This can be used once per creature per battle.

Fairy.name: Treaty Bind
Fairy.description: You create a magical contract between two willing or unwilling creatures. If either breaks an agreed condition, they take 1d12 + MOVE fairy damage, ignoring immunity but not resistance. If this move is used on unwilling creatures, they must succeed Charisma saving throws to resist the contract.
Fairy.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 5d6 at level 10 and 5d10 at level 17.

Fairy.name: Whispering Winds
Fairy.description: You call upon the whispers of the forest to aid you, disorienting and disheartening opponents in range. For the duration, all creatures within 50 feet of you, that have the intention to harm you, are forced to make a WIS save. On a failure, they suffer -5 to hit this turn. On a natural roll of 1, they become frightened as well. Deaf creatures are unaffected by this move.

Fighting.name: Arm Thrust
Fighting.description:
You unleash a flurry of fists on an opponent.
Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE fighting
damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4.
On a result of 3 or 4, you may immediately hit again for an
additional 1d4 fighting damage. Continue this process until
you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of
four additional hits.
Fighting.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Aura Sphere
Fighting.description:
You focus your aura into a concentrated blast that strikes an opponent in range. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage, except when targeting an opponent in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Dig,
Bounce, etc.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Brick Break
Fighting.description: You strike out with a powerful and focused punch. Make a melee attack roll on an opponent, doing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a hit, this move automatically ends an opponent’s Light Screen, and bypasses Reflect with no effect.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Bulk Up
Fighting.description:
You pump yourself up, increasing your
adrenaline. For the next minute, choose to add +1 to your
attack rolls OR +1 to AC. This move can be stacked to a
maximum of +5 for either choice.

Fighting.name: Cataclysm Punch
Fighting.description: You strike with the force of a natural disaster. Make a melee attack with advantage against a single target dealing 10d12 + MOVE fighting damage. The target must make a CON save or be stunned for 1 round. Regardless of the save, the target is pushed back 30ft. Creatures Huge or larger are instead staggered, losing their reaction and having disadvantage on their next attack. This move can be used once per long rest. If this attack misses, the VP is spent, but the move is not expended and may be used again until it hits.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Circle Throw
Fighting.description: You grab and hurl the opponent across the battlefield. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On hit, throw the target in a direction of your choice: 30ft if your size or smaller, 15ft if one size larger, or 5ft if two or more sizes larger. If the target collides with a solid surface or another creature, both take 1d6 typeless damage.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Close Combat
Fighting.description: You get in close for a devastating strike, sacrificing your defenses. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit, rolled with advantage. After activating this move, your AC is reduced by 1d4, and the target has advantage on any attack it makes against you, until the beginning of your next turn.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Counter
Fighting.description: When you are hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to make a melee attack of opportunity against your foe, doing 1d4 + MOVE fighting damage on a successful hit.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Cross Chop
Fighting.description: You crush an opponent with a strong sideways strike. Make a melee attack against a target, doing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. Cross Chop results in a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Detect
Fighting.description: You sense incoming danger and are able to quickly avoid it. When targeted, before the attack roll, or when forced to make a saving throw, you may automatically avoid taking damage on the first instance of this reaction. On future reactions in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful. Unless the successful roll is 20, the damage you take instead drains your VP for half the damage amount.

Fighting.name: Double Kick
Fighting.description: You strike twice with two devastating kicks. Make two melee attack rolls, doing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on each successful hit.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Drain Punch
Fighting.description: Your strike a foe with an energy-draining punch. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit, healing you for half the damage dealt.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Dynamic Punch
Fighting.description: You strike out with a twirling punch that confuses your foes. Make a melee attack roll against an opponent, doing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a hit, it also becomes confused.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Final Gambit
Fighting.description: You risk everything and use your own life force to damage a creature in range. The target takes an amount of fighting damage equal to your remaining HP and VP. This damage ignores resistance and immunity to fighting type. You then faint and gain 3 levels of exhaustion.

Fighting.name: Flying Press
Fighting.description: You dive at a creature with quick reaction speed, able to change the type of attack when you reach them. Make a melee attack against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE flying OR fighting damage, depending on your choice. STAB can only added to this move if its type is fighting.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Focus Blast
Fighting.description: You heighten your focus and unleash it upon a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Focus Punch
Fighting.description: When activating this move, you spend your action focusing your next attack. If you keep concentration, as an action on your next turn, make an attack roll against a creature, doing 3d12 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If concentration is broken, the move fails and VP is spent.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d10 at level 5, 6d12 at level 10, and 10d10 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Force Palm
Fighting.description: You thrust your palm outward with such strength that a shockwave is sent towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target is paralyzed.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Hammer Arm
Fighting.description: You put all your power into a strong and heavy fist attack. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. Until the end of your next turn, you have disadvantage on all DEX saves and your speed is halved.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 4d8 at level 5, 6d8 at level 10, and 8d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: High Horsepower
Fighting.description: You fiercely attack the target using your entire body. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit, and if the target is your size or smaller, it is knocked prone.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: High Jump Kick
Fighting.description: You leap into the air to deliver a strong kick to a target. Make a melee attack, doing 5d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a miss, you take damage equal to half the maximum damage of this move and fall prone.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 7d10 at level 5, 9d10 at level 10, and 14d10 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Jump Kick
Fighting.description: You leap into the air to deliver a strong kick to a creature. Make a melee attack against, doing 4d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. On a miss, you take damage equal to half the maximum damage of this move and fall prone.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d8 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Karate Chop
Fighting.description: You extend a hand towards a target creature for a savage karate chop. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. Karate Chop scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Limit Break
Fighting.description: Requires below 50% HP to activate. Make a melee attack dealing 4d12 + MOVE fighting damage. This attack has advantage and scores a critical hit on 18-20.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Low Kick
Fighting.description: You kick out at a creature’s lower half, dealing damage and attempting to knock it off balance. Make a melee attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target falls prone and flinches.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Low Sweep
Fighting.description: You sweep your legs at the lower half of a creature's body. Make a melee attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage and knocking the target prone on a hit.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Mach Punch
Fighting.description: You rush forward to punch with incredible speed. Choose a target within 10 feet of you. You rush forward to slam a fist into the creature, avoiding all attacks of opportunity. Make a melee attack on that creature, dealing 1d10 fighting damage on a hit.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Mat Block
Fighting.description: You conjure up a ethereal, protective mat to shield you and your allies. Until the end of your next turn, any ally creature within 15 feet of you (including you) is immune to damage from damaging moves. Status-inducing moves can still affect their targets.

Fighting.name: No Retreat
Fighting.description: As a bonus action, you resolve to stay in the fight until the bitter end. You gain +2 AC, STR, DEX, CON, WIS, INT, and CHA, as well as 5+ Speed for the rest of the encounter. Until the end of this encounter, you may not flee or be switched out. At the end of this round, move to the top of the initiative order. This move can only be used once per encounter.

Fighting.name: Power-Up Punch
Fighting.description: You strike out with a powerful punch that builds momentum. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on hit. For each successful hit with this move, you gain a stack of Power-Up (max stacks = proficiency bonus). Add 1d6 to all your melee damage rolls and an additional 1VP cost for using a melee move per stack. All stacks are lost if you are incapacitated or at the end of combat.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Quick Guard
Fighting.description: You have the ability to rush to the aid of an ally at the start of combat. If an ally in range (or you) is attacked on the very first turn of the very first round of combat, you may use your reaction to negate any damage dealt.

Fighting.name: Revenge
Fighting.description: You invoke a fight within to retaliate against a creature that damages you. As a reaction, when you are hit with a melee attack that deals damage, make a melee attack roll against your attacker, with disadvantage. On a hit, deal the same amount of fighting type damage back at your attacker.

Fighting.name: Reversal
Fighting.description: You unleash an all out attack that is stronger the less HP you have. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If you are below 50% of your maximum health, double the damage. If you are at 25% or below of your maximum health, triple the damage. The multiplier for this attack occurs before the multiplier for resistances or vulnerabilities.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Rock Smash
Fighting.description: You strike out with a rock-crushing attack that may lower a user’s defense. Make an attack roll against a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target’s AC decreases by 1 while it remains in battle. On rock types, this move is a critical hit on a natural attack roll of 18 or higher.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Rolling Kick
Fighting.description: You swing your feet around in a wide arc to strike a target. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target flinches.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Sacred Sword
Fighting.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with one of your sharp appendages. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. This move ignores any boosts affecting the target's AC.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Secret Sword
Fighting.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with one of your sharp appendages. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. This move ignores any boosts affecting the target's AC.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Seismic Toss
Fighting.description: You lift and slam a creature into the ground. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d6 + MOVE fighting damage. For each size category the target is above Small, add 2d6 to the damage.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d8 at level 5, 2d10 at level 10, and 2d12 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Sky Uppercut
Fighting.description: You unleash a devastating uppercutting fist that continues to strike skyward with force. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. This move can target creatures in the invulnerable stages of Fly, Bounce and Sky Drop, if the target used that move within range.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Storm Throw
Fighting.description: You strike a target with a perfectly placed blow. Make a melee attack dealing 2d8 + MOVE fighting damage on hit. This attack is always a critical hit. If the target is immune to critical hits, the attack deals normal damage instead.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Submission
Fighting.description: You attempt a forceful grapple on a target. Make a melee attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit, but taking a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil. On a hit, the target is grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. While a creature is grappled, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage with a quarter of the damage dealt in typeless recoil.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Superpower
Fighting.description: You strike a target with incredible power. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. This move exhausts you; your STR and DEX ability scores are set to 10 until the end of your next turn.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Triple Kick
Fighting.description: You strike out with three consecutive kicks. Make three melee attack rolls in order, doing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on each hit. As soon as one attack misses, the move is over.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Vacuum Wave
Fighting.description: You whirl your fists with a fast attack that pushes a quick burst of wind at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 fighting damage on a hit.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Vital Throw
Fighting.description: You wind up a slow but unstoppable strike. This move always goes last in the initiative order. Make an attack that automatically hits a creature in melee range, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage. If you are grappling the target, double the damage dice for this move.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Wake-Up Slap
Fighting.description: You attack with a jolting slap from your palms. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fighting damage on a hit. If the target is asleep, double the damage dice and roll damage with advantage, but the target automatically wakes up.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fighting.name: Worldbreaker Fist
Fighting.description: You strike with force that shatters the ground. Make a melee attack dealing 4d12 + MOVE fighting damage. On hit, all creatures within 10ft of the target (except you) must make a DEX save or take 2d12 ground damage and be knocked prone.
Fighting.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Blast Burn
Fire.description: Explosive projectiles rain down upon your opponents in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Any creature caught in the blast must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC or take 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a fail and half as much on a success. This move saps you of energy, and you may not make any attack until after the end of your next turn.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Blaze Kick
Fire.description: Flames burst from your feet as you deliver a powerful kick. Make a melee attack on an opponent, doing 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or more, the target is burned. This move scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Blue Flare
Fire.description: You unleash an intense and beautiful line of blue flames in a 50 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the line must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE fire damage and being burned on a failure, or half as much without being burned on a success.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Burning Glance
Fire.description: When hit by a melee attack, you may use this reaction to make a melee attack, dealing 1d6 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a critical hit, no additional damage is done, but you regain the damage done as VP.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Chronoflame
Fire.description: You let out a stream of primordial purple flames at a target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. The target must then roll a d4. On a result of 1-2, the target suffers one level of exhaustion. With each subsequent hit to the same target during one combat, add 1d12 cosmic damage to the damage roll.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Dark Ember
Fire.description: You hurl a ball of peculiar flames at a point on the ground within range. A 5ft. diameter flame that casts shadows instead of light burns 5ft. tall in this spot until the beginning of your next turn, doing 2d8 + Move fire damage to any creature occupying the space at the beginning of their turn. Additionally, the creature must succeed a WIS saving throw, or take 2d8 + MOVE dark damage as well on a failed save.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Dawn Dance
Fire.description:
Using this move drains 2d12 of the user's hit points.
You create a swirling vortex of mystical flames. All creatures in a 30ft. radius must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, they take 4d12 + MOVE fire damage and 3d10 fairy damage, and suffer one of the following effects: Roll a d4 to determine the effect.
1: Charmed until end of next turn
2: Burned
3: Blinded until end of next turn
4: Moved 15ft in a random direction
On a successful save, they take half damage and suffer no effect. This move may be used once per long rest.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 and 5d8 at level 5, 8d12 and 6d10 at level 10, and 14d12 and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Dragonfire
Fire.description: You spend one turn drawing in air, readying your attack. Next turn, you let out a stream of intense flames in a line 5 feet wide, creating an explosion with a radius of 10 feet on the first creature hit. All creatures caught in the explosion must make a CON save against your move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the roll by 5 or more, it is burned.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Ember
Fire.description:
You hurl a ball of flame at a target within range. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d6 + Move fire damage on a
successful hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, the target is burnt.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Eruption
Fire.description: You spew hot magma in a 15 foot cone. Any creature caught in the blast must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If you are at full health when activating this move, double your STAB bonus when dealing damage, and roll damage with advantage.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Ether Pyre
Fire.description: Ethereal blue flames flare up around you and cover your body. For the duration, gain 5+ to your AC, and water moves evaporate when they hit you.

Fire.name: Fiery Dance
Fire.description: You dance and kick up a blaze, sending flames in a 15 foot circle, centered on you. Anyone caught in the blaze must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by 5 or more, double the MOVE modifier when adding damage. This move may be used once per short rest.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fire Blast
Fire.description: Two pillars of raging hot flames explode out from you towards up to two creatures in range. The creature(s) targeted must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save by 5 or more become burned.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fire Fang
Fire.description: You attempt to pierce a creature with flamecloaked fangs. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned and flinches.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fire Lash
Fire.description: You strike out at a target in range with a burning lash, Make a melee attack on a creature, doing 2d8 + MOVE fire damage. On a successful attack, the targeted creature must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a fail, allies add +1 to any attack targeted at the creature for the duration. This modifier can be stacked if it fails multiple Fire Lash saves, up to a maximum of +5.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fire Pledge
Fire.description: You send a plume of flame towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fire Punch
Fire.description: You strike out with fire-infused fists. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fire Shield
Fire.description: Thin, wispy flames dance around you, shedding bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The flames grant resistance to cold temperatures. In addition, whenever a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the shield erupts with flame. The attacker takes 2d8 fire damage.

Fire.name: Fire Spin
Fire.description: You release a series of moving flames that dance around a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. As long as you maintain concentration, the target takes an additional 1d10 fire damage at the end of each of its next three turns.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Flame Burst
Fire.description: You release a fireball that explodes on contact. Choose a point in range. Any creature within 5 feet of that point must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit, or half as much on a success.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Flame Charge
Fire.description: You cloak yourself with flame and lash out at a creature. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. With each successful hit from this move, increase your movement speed by 5 until you are incapacitated, are switched out, or the combat ends. (Maximum of +30 to movement speed)
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Flame Wheel
Fire.description: A wheel of flame explodes out from you in a 10 foot radius. All creature in the area must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a fail and half as much on a save. If the user is frozen, this move can still be used, thawing out the creature during the attack. This move can be used once per short rest.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Flamethrower
Fire.description: You shoot a stream of flames in an 40 foot cone. All creatures caught in the cone must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half damage on a success. Any creature that fails the save by 5 or more becomes burned.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Flare Blitz
Fire.description: You cloak yourself in fire and charge at a creature with serious damage. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a hit, you take a quarter of the damage dealt in recoil damage. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the target is burned. If the user is frozen, this move can still be used, and the user is thawed out.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Fusion Flare
Fire.description: You summon a gigantic fireball that strikes down from the heavens in a 15 foot radius, centered on a point within range. All creatures caught in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If Fusion Bolt or Fusion Flare was already used this round, double the damage dealt. Fusion Flare may be used to thaw out the user from the frozen status before attacking.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Heat Crash
Fire.description: You slam into a creature with your flaming body. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing a minimum of 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. Add an additional bonus to damage equal to your MOVE modifier for each size level you are above a creature. (Sizes, in order, are: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gigantic)
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Heat Wave
Fire.description: You exhale a wave of hot breath in a 15ft. cone. Creatures caught in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on failure, or half as much on a success. If the creature fails the save by 5 or more, it is burned.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Incinerate
Fire.description: You summon forth a burning hot flame that surrounds a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. On a hit, if the target is holding a berry, it is immediately burned to ash, becoming unusable.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Fire.name: Infernal Eye
Fire.description: Your body flares up into a fireball looking like a flaming eye, shooting a stream of fire in an 80ft. line. All creatures caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC or take 3d10 + MOVE fire damage and be burned on a failure, or half as much without being burned on a success.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Inferno
Fire.description: You engulf a target in intense flames. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit, burning the target in the process.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Lava Cannon
Fire.description: You emit a stream of superheated lava in a 60ft. line. All creatures caught in the line must make a DEX saving throw, taking 3d12 + MOVE fire damage and 1d12 rock damage, or half damage on a success. On a failed save, creatures hit are pushed back 10ft.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 4d12 and 2d12 at level 5, 5d12 and 3d12 at level 10, and 10d12 and 4d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Lava Plume
Fire.description: You summon forth a plume of raging hot fire in a 10 foot radius, 40-feet tall cylinder, centered on a point within range. Creatures in the blast must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a failure and become burned, or half as much without becoming burned on a success. You may spend additional VP to gain extra height for this attack, 4VP for 1d10 extra height, to a maximum of extra height dice equal to your proficiency bonus.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Magma Storm
Fire.description: You stir up a maelstrom of fire in a 20ft radius, 15ft tall, centered on a point within range, that continues to rage as long as you hold your concentration. Any creature that enters this area for the first time on their turn, or is in that area at the beginning of their turn must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Meatball Meteor
Fire.description: You summon forth a flaming meateor shower that rains down on your opponents. All creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range, must take a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit, or half as much on a save. After activating this move, your next attack is rolled at disadvantage. If that attack requires a saving throw, the target has advantage.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Mystical Fire
Fire.description: You summon forth a pair of mystical flames that dance around a target, dealing damage. Make a ranged attack roll against a target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. If the target is hit with this attack, any attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn is rolled at disadvantage.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Overheat
Fire.description: With a roar, flames burst from your body in a 15 foot radius, centered on you. Any creature in range must roll a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. The power of the move exhausts you, and your next attack is done at disadvantage. If your next attack requires a creature saving throw, they have advantage. This move can be used once per short rest.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Purgatory
Fire.description:
You conjure a vortex of blue ethereal flames that superheats the air in a 10ft. radius, 40ft. high cylinder from a point within range. All creatures caught in the vortex are forced to make a CON save against your move DC. On a successful save, the creatures lose 4d12 + MOVE VP, and on a failure, they lose 4d12 + MOVE VP and all stat changes are removed.
This move must be recharged by using Ether Pyre after its first use in a battle.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Sacred Fire
Fire.description: You unleash a devastating, concentrated blast of flame at a single target in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 10 or more, the target is burned.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Searing Flame
Fire.description: You breathe a small, concentrated purple flame towards a target. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. The magical fire burns away one positive effect on a hostile target, or one negative effect if used on an ally.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Searing Shot
Fire.description: Searing hot flames lick out at creatures in a 10 foot circle, centered on you. Any creature in range must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a target fails the save by 5 or more, it is burned. This move can be used once per short rest.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Shell Trap
Fire.description: You set a shell trap that explodes in a 5ft radius. As a bonus action on the initial activation of this move, you set a trap on yourself. Only one trap may be set at a time. When you are hit by an attack, you can use a reaction to detonate the trap. Creatures within 5 feet of you must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, rolling at disadvantage, taking 3d10 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Fire.name: Sun Disc
Fire.description: A magic lens appears between your horns, amplifying the rays of the sun for one turn. On your next turn, the sunlight is focused into an intense and beautiful line of white light in a 50 foot line, 5 feet wide. Any creature caught in the line must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by more than 5, they are burned and blinded for three turns. In strong sunlight, this move does not need charging. In darkness, this move costs 10VP extra.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Sunny Day
Fire.description: You change the weather around you to harsh sunlight for 5 rounds.

Fire.name: Superheat
Fire.description: The air around you becomes intensely hot for 5 rounds.

Fire.name: Supernova
Fire.description:
You begin to glow white hot. When you activate this move, you may immediately release the blast at 30ft radius, or continue charging. On each subsequent turn, you may use your action to release or continue charging. The blast automatically releases on Turn 3.

Activation (Turn 1): 30ft radius
Turn 2: 60ft radius
Turn 3: 100ft radius (auto-release)

While charging, creatures within the current radius must spend double movement to move away from you.
When released (or if you are reduced to 0 HP while charging), all creatures in range must make a Constitution saving throw, taking 10d12 + MOVE fire damage on a failure, or half on a success. Creatures that fail are deafened for 1 minute; creatures that succeed are deafened for 3 rounds.
After the explosion, make a DC 18 Constitution saving throw. On a failure, you faint and are stable. If the blast triggered from reaching 0 HP, you automatically fail this save.
This move can only be used once per long rest.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 12d12 at level 5, 15d12 at level 10, and 20d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: V-create
Fire.description: Your forehead burns like hot coals as you slam your head into a creature. Make a melee attack roll, dealing 4d12 + MOVE fire damage on a hit. After activating this move, your AC decreases by 2 until the beginning of your next turn. Until your next long rest, each use of this move after the first doubles the current AC debuff.
Fire.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Fire.name: Watchful Embers
Fire.description:
You scatter small burning eyes that trace a creature after a successful hit. For the duration, moves you execute may originate from the Watchful Embers.
The creature affected may use their action to attempt a WIS save against your move DC to get rid of the Watchful Embers on the beginning of their turn.

Fire.name: Will-O-Wisp
Fire.description: You send a sinister, white-hot flame at a creature attempting to inflict a burn. Make a ranged attack roll on a target, causing burn on a hit.

Flying.name: Acrobatics
Flying.description: You nimbly attack a target with acrobatic prowess. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. If you are unencumbered when using this move, damage is rolled with advantage.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Aerial Ace
Flying.description: You dive at an opponent with such speed that it is impossible for them to avoid. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d10 + MOVE flying damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Aerial Post
Flying.description: While in the air, you dive at a creature in range, ignoring your flying speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack, doing 1d10 + MOVE flying damage on a hit.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Aeroblast
Flying.description:
You shoot out a powerful vortex of air that shreds through opponents. All creatures caught in a 50 foot line, 5 feet wide, must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a fail, and
half as much on a save.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Air Cutter
Flying.description: You create a gust of razor-like wind to slash an opponent. Make a ranged attack against an opponent, doing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on 19 and 20.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Air Slash
Flying.description: You slash at an opponent with a blade of sharp air. Make a ranged attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or higher, the target flinches if it has not taken a turn this round.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Bone Crush
Flying.description: You may fly up to 30ft without provoking attacks of opportunity as part of your movement this turn. Then, drop towards a creature in range. Make an attack roll against your target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE flying or ground damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or higher, the target must succeed a Dexterity saving throw or have their AC reduced by 2 until the end of their next turn. This effect triggers on lower numbers, and the saving throw DC is increased by 1 for every 10ft. of height above 10ft. dropped during the attack. On a natural 20 attack roll, this move does maximum damage and the saving throw always fails. On a miss, you take fall damage appropriate to the height dropped.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Bounce
Flying.description: When you activate this move, you bounce high into the air, disappearing into the Ethereal plane. You may not be targeted by attacks in the Ethereal plane. On your next turn, as an action, you reappear and attempt to slam down on top of an opponent. Make a melee attack roll on an opponent in range, with advantage, doing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or more, the target is paralyzed.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Brave Bird
Flying.description: You tuck in your wings and dive at an opponent. Make a melee attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. On a hit, you also take a quarter of the total (rounded down) in recoil damage.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Chatter
Flying.description: You shout a series of disorienting words at an opponent, scrambling their senses. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, deal 1d10 + MOVE flying damage. Natural attack rolls of 18 or higher cause the target to become confused.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Defog
Flying.description:
You summon a swift, magical breeze in a 50 foot
radius, centered on you, that sweeps away foggy weather
and obstacles. When activating this move, any area of effect
moves that are still active end immediately (Examples:
Misty Terrain, Fog Cloud, Smog, etc.).

Flying.name: Drill Peck
Flying.description: You hammer down on an enemy with a peck attack. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing 1d10 + MOVE flying damage on a successful hit. Drill Peck scores a critical hit on 19s and 20s.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Falcon Dive
Flying.description: While in the air, you dive at a creature in range, ignoring your flying speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack roll, doing 3d10 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. You always have advantage when using this move. On a natural roll of 19 or 20, the target is knocked prone.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Feather Dance
Flying.description:
You distract a creature in range with a beautiful dance. The target must make a WIS saving throw against
your Move DC. On a fail, the target cannot add proficiency to its attack rolls for the duration.

Flying.name: Feather Spear
Flying.description: You let loose a flurry of razor sharp feathers in a 15 foot cone. All creatures caught in the flurry are forced to make a DEX save against your move DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a failure, and half as much on a success.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Fly
Flying.description: You fly high into the air to prepare for a dive bomb attack. When you activate this move, you flap your wings and disappear into the Ethereal plane above you. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are in the Ethereal plane. On your next turn, you use your action to reappear and make a diving melee attack on a creature in range, with advantage, dealing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a successful hit.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Gust
Flying.description: You create a strong wind that batters a target in range. Make a ranged attack, doing 1d6 + MOVE flying damage on a hit.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Hover
Flying.description: When targeted or otherwise affected by a Ground type move affecting grounded creatures, you swiftly take flight, dodging ground based Ground moves until the beginning of your next turn.

Flying.name: Hurricane
Flying.description: You wrap a creature in a fierce wind. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. If this attack is activated during rain, roll the attack with advantage. If used during harsh sunlight, roll the attack with disadvantage. If the natural attack roll is 15 or higher, the target becomes confused.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Hypersonic Flight
Flying.description: ou channel all of your energy into flying at a breakneck speed. For this turn, multiply your flying speed by 1d4 + MOVE. You can't be targeted or trigger attacks of opportunity while in hypersonic flight. All creatures you pass within 10ft of must make a CON save or become deafened for 1 minute. Your next melee attack this turn deals additional damage based on the distance traveled (1d6 per 10ft, max +10d6). You take recoil damage equal to half the bonus damage dealt. Attacking while in hypersonic flight ends the effect. This move may only be used once per long rest.

Flying.name: Mirror Move
Flying.description: You perform the same move made by a chosen target after your last turn, using your own statistics for bonuses and Move saves if applicable.

Flying.name: Oblivion Wing
Flying.description: You extend your wings and use a dark beam of energy to absorb the target's life force. Make a ranged attack against a creature, dealing 3d10 + MOVE flying damage on a hit, recovering your own hit points by the amount of damage dealt.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Peck
Flying.description: You hammer down on a target with a peck attack. Make a melee attack roll on a target, doing 1d6 + MOVE flying damage on a successful hit.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Pluck
Flying.description: You peck at a target, attempting to grab their held berry. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. On a hit, if the target is holding a berry, you swallow it immediately and gain its effect.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Roost
Flying.description: You land on the ground to rest your body. Regain 2d8 + MOVE hit points, but become grounded and lose your ground-type resistance until the beginning of your next turn. You can't move after activating this move on the same turn.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Sky Attack
Flying.description: When you use this move, you flap your wings menacingly and prepare to strike a creature within range. On your next turn’s action, if you keep your concentration, you dive at a creature in range, ignoring your flying speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Your target is forced to succeed a DEX save, taking 3d10 + MOVE flying damage and have disadvantage on attacks against you until the end of its next turn on a failure, half as much on a success.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Sky Drop
Flying.description: You reach out in an attempt to lift a creature up in the air for a slamming attack. When you activate this move, make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target is grappled. The target may use its next action to attempt a STR save against your Move DC to get free. If it does not succeed, and you maintain your concentration, you may use your action on your next turn to lift the creature into the air, slamming it to the ground for 2d8 + MOVE flying damage.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Skyward Soar
Flying.description: You quickly take to the skies as a creature is about to attack you, before it rolls to hit. For this instant, you increase your AC by 10. If this causes the attack to miss, you're now 60ft. up in the air. Subsequent use of this move during the same encounter requires a roll of 15 or higher.

Flying.name: Stormwind
Flying.description: You summon strong winds that cover the battlefield for 5 rounds.

Flying.name: Strafe
Flying.description: While in the air, you dive at a creature in range, ignoring your flying speed and any opportunity attacks you may incur. Make a melee attack roll, doing 2d8 + MOVE flying damage on a hit. After a successful hit, you may fly to a position within 30ft. of the target or you may immediately switch out as a free action if you're within 60ft. of your trainer.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Flying.name: Tailwind
Flying.description: You whip up a turbulent whirlwind that boosts the speed of you and all allies in a 30 foot circle, centered on you. The wind only follows you and your allies, and doubles their movement speed for the duration.

Flying.name: Wing Attack
Flying.description: You strike out at a target creature with your wings. Make a melee attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE flying damage on a hit.
Flying.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Flying.name: Wing Command
Flying.description: You spread your wings in a majestic display, inspiring allies close by. All allies within range that can see you receive a bonus to their attack rolls equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier, lasting until the beginning of your next turn.
Flying.scaling: The bonus dice granted from this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10 and 2d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: 5. Enervation Ray
Ghost.description: You fire a draining ray. The targeted creature must succeed a Constitution saving throw, taking 2d8 MOVE + Ghost damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one. The damage from this move affects VP. The user regains half of the damage dealt as VP.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Astonish
Ghost.description: You startle an opponent with a loud shout . Make a ranged attack roll against an opponent doing 1d6 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 15 or more, the opponent flinches.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Cerulean Haunt
Ghost.description: Your body glows a strange blue, creating horrifying visions in the minds of a creature in range that is asleep. Make a ranged attack roll, incapacitating the creature for 1d4 + MOVE turns on a hit. The creature wakes up, but is unable to do anything for the duration. On a critical hit, the creature loses half of its remaining HP or VP.
Ghost.scaling: The creature is incapacitated for 1d6 turns at level 5, 1d8 turns at level 10, and 3d4 turns at level 17.

Ghost.name: Confuse Ray
Ghost.description: You target an opponent in range with a sinister ray of ghostly light. The target must succeed a WIS saving throw or become confused.

Ghost.name: Curse
Ghost.description:
This Move has a different effect based on your Pokémon type. If you are ghost-type: You attempt to put a curse on an opponent. Force a target in range to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a fail, the target is cursed. You take 2d8 damage initially and your opponent takes 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage at the end of each of its turns for the duration. If you are any other type: You place a curse on yourself. For the duration, your STR and CON scores increase by 2, but your DEX score decreases by 4.
Out of combat, the ghost curse deals damage every 10 minutes.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Cursed Gaze
Ghost.description: Your eyes open wide and fixate on one creature in range, casting a devastating curse. Make a ranged attack. On a hit, force the creature to attempt a WIS save against your move DC. On a failure, the creature gets -1 to AC, STR, DEX, CON, WIS, INT, and CHA, and they can't flee or be switched out for the rest of the encounter. The effect stacks for a maximum of 5 times. On a success, nothing happens.
Ghost.scaling: At level 10, the stat debuff increases to -2, and at level 17 it increases to -3.

Ghost.name: Destiny Bond
Ghost.description:
You create a dark, internal bond with an
opponent. Select a target in range, who must make a WIS
save against your Move DC. On a fail, if you faint during the
combat, the opponent must take damage equal to twice the
damage of the same type that caused you to faint.

Ghost.name: Ether Flame
Ghost.description: You engulf a target in strange flames. Make a ranged attack against a target, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit, burning the target on a critical hit. This move does critical damage to burning targets.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Ethereal Vines
Ghost.description: A thicket of ghostly vines shoot from your body, wrapping around a creature in range. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. The creature is also grappled. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may use an action to attempt an escape with a STR save against your Move DC. As long as the target is grappled on your subsequent turns, this move can be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 3d10 ghost damage.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Grudge
Ghost.description: When you take damage from a move that reduces you to zero hit points, you may use your reaction to force the attacker to make a WIS saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, the creature loses 3d10 VP. On the first instance of this happening in one encounter, you regain the VP drained as HP. On subsequent instances of this move being used in the same combat encounter, you must succeed a DC15 on a d20 roll for the healing to take effect.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Hex
Ghost.description: You send a ghostly energy at a creature that does additional damage to those affected by status conditions. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. If the target is affected by a status condition, damage is rolled with advantage.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Lick
Ghost.description: You reach out and lick a target. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, do 1d6 + MOVE ghost damage. On a natural attack roll of 18 or higher, the target becomes paralyzed.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Moongeist Beam
Ghost.description: You emit a sinister ray that explodes out from you in a 100 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must make a WIS save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a failure or half as much on a success. This attack ignores any of the creatures abilities that would affect the user's ability to hit or deal full damage.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Night Shade
Ghost.description: You hit a target with a wave of dark energy. Make a ranged attack against a target. On a hit, this move deals 1d10 + MOVE ghost damage, adding the user’s level to the damage.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Nightmare
Ghost.description: Choose one sleeping creature you are aware of within 600 feet. It must make a WIS save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. This move does not wake the target, but will cause a long rest to fail. This move can only be used once per long rest.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Ominous Wind
Ghost.description: You stir up a gust of repulsive wind that strikes a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, increase all of your ability scores by +1 for three rounds.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Phantom Force
Ghost.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise your target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you use your action to reappear and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Phantom Gate
Ghost.description: You attempt to tear open a rift between the plane you currently inhabit, and the Depths of Twilight, creating a swirling portal of spectral energy. Roll a d10. The portal is stable for as many rounds as the rolled result. The gateway appears on the ground as a 10-foot diameter circular opening surrounded by wisps of shadow and ethereal mist, through which the dark, twisted landscape of the Depths of Twilight can be glimpsed. After the amount of stable turns have passed, you may attempt to keep the portal open by succeeding a DC15 arcana skill check as a bonus action, for a maximum of 10 turns.
Ghost.scaling: At level 15, you may spend more VP to make the portal bigger, doubling the cost for each size level.

Ghost.name: Phantom Tendril
Ghost.description: You extend a sharp vine or similar appendage to whip the target with, appearing from unexpected angles. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. This move is unaffected by any of the target's stat changes or protection moves/reactions.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Phantom Tentacles
Ghost.description: You use your long ethereal tentacles to strike a creature in range. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ghost damage.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Pharaoh's Curse
Ghost.description: When a creature in range successfully lands an attack against you or an ally, a magical dark eye opens on your forehead, striking fear and hopelessness into the creature that hit you. The creature is frightened by you, and has disadvantage on all rolls until the end of its next turn.

Ghost.name: Shadow Ball
Ghost.description: You hurl a sphere of magical darkness at a creature. Make a ranged attack, doing 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. On a hit, the ball expands and covers the creatures face, granting them a -2 to hit on any attack they make before the end of their next turn.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Shadow Bone
Ghost.description: You strike out with a bone-infused with a wayward spirt. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 18 or higher, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 while it remains in battle. This decrease may be stacked up to a maximum of -5 to AC.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Shadow Claw
Ghost.description: You strike with a sharp claw made from shadows in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. This moves scores a critical hit on natural attack rolls of 19 and 20.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Shadow Force
Ghost.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise a target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you use may your action to reappear at a point within range and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing 4d12 + MOVE ghost damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Shadow Punch
Ghost.description: You throw a punch from the surrounding shadows, unavoidable by any creature. This move is guaranteed to hit for 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Shadow Sneak
Ghost.description: You extend your shadow to strike a creature from behind. As a bonus action, you can control your shadow to make a ranged attack roll against a target within range dealing 1d6 ghost damage on a hit.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Silent Approach
Ghost.description: A ghostly darkness envelops you, hiding you, masking your scent and dampening the noise you make. For the duration, gain advantage on stealth checks. Other creatures have disadvantage when attempting to locate you with a perception check using sight, smell or hearing.

Ghost.name: Soul Drain
Ghost.description: The user attempts to drain the life force of a creature within 30 feet. The target must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, it takes 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage and has disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws for 1 minute. The user regains hit points equal to half the damage dealt.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Spectral Chains
Ghost.description: The user creates ghostly chains that attempt to bind a target within 60 feet. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, the target is restrained and cannot teleport or leave its current plane. At the end of each of its turns, the target can repeat the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Ghost.name: Spectral Surge
Ghost.description: You may use this reaction whenever a creature in range is using a stat boosting move. A strong ghostly current attempts to steal the stat boost effect and give it to you. Make a ranged attack roll, stealing the stat bonus on a hit.

Ghost.name: Spectral Thief
Ghost.description: You succumb to darkness and transport yourself into a creature's shadow. Immediately teleport to a point in range and make a melee attack on a creature. On hit, you steal all positive stat changes affecting the creature (increases to AC, attack rolls, damage bonuses, etc.) and deal 3d10 + MOVE ghost damage.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Spectral Vision
Ghost.description: You foresee the next move of a creature, allowing you to react immediately. When targeted by a move, or forced to make a saving throw, you may automatically avoid the damage/effects on the first instance of this reaction, and then use a move you know, targeting your attacker. You must pay the VP cost of both this move and the move you choose to activate as a reaction. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

Ghost.name: Spirit Shackle
Ghost.description: You employ dark energy to stitch a creature’s shadow to the ground. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE ghost damage on a hit. On hit, the target is unable to flee or switch out while the user remains in battle.
Ghost.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Ghost.name: Spite
