Rock.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Rock.name: Stealth Rock
Rock.description: You prepare jagged rocks to strike creatures that reveal themselves. For 1 minute (concentration), when a creature first becomes visible to you (entering your line of sight, appearing from stealth, being switched in, or emerging from teleportation), you may use your reaction to make a ranged attack against it, dealing 1d6 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. This reaction does not consume your reaction for the round. You can use this ability a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus per casting.
Rock.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Rock.name: Stone Edge
Rock.description: The earth moves beneath a target’s feet as sharp stone pierce through the ground underneath them. Creatures in a 10 foot radius centered on a point you choose in range must make a DEX save against your MOVE DC, taking 2d8 + MOVE rock damage on a fail, or half as much on a save.
Rock.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Rock.name: Stone Maw
Rock.description: You bite down on an opponent in an attempt to swallow it. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE rock damage on a hit. If the creature is smaller than you, it has to make a DEX save against your move DC. On a failure, you swallow it, and it is considered grappled and restrained. At the start of the swallowed creature's turns, it takes 1d12 rock damage. On its turn, it may attempt to free itself by succeeding a STR contest against your CON, with disadvantage. If you lose half or more of your current HP in a single turn while having swallowed a creature, you must succeed a DC15 CON save, or have to spit out the swallowed creature.
Rock.scaling:
The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

The damage done at the start of a swallowed creature's turn becomes 4d6 + your STR modifier after level 10.

Rock.name: Wide Guard
Rock.description: You have the ability to guard your allies from area-of-effect moves. As a reaction, when a creature activates a damaging move that damages multiple allies within range, you may halve the damage dealt. On future instances of this reaction in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll or forfeit the reaction with no effect.

Steel.name: Autotomize
Steel.description:
You shed away part of your body to make
yourself lighter and increase your speed. For the duration,
your speed increases by 10 feet. This move may be stacked
to a maximum speed increase of 30 feet.

Steel.name: Bell Toll
Steel.description: You emit a loud chime that can be heard by all creatures in range. Affected creatures will wake up, and can't fall asleep for the duration. While tolling, creatures that begin their turn within 15ft. of you must succeed a CON save at the beginning of their turns, or take 2d8 + MOVE steel damage. Failing the save by 5 or more causes critical damage and deafness for 1 minute.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Bullet Punch
Steel.description: You strike with a punch that is quick as a bullet. At the beginning of a round of combat, you may announce that you are using this move, immediately jumping to the top of the initiative order for that round only. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Coin Toss
Steel.description: You hurl small metal objects towards a target. Make two ranged attacks, doing 1d4 steel damage on each successful hit. You may pay 25 x the damage rolled to double the damage of a hit from this move once per target per encounter.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 2d6 at level 10, and 3d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Debris Break
Steel.description: You clamp down on a target, attempting to crush it. Make an attack roll, dealing 1d12 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a successful hit, the target is considered grappled. If the first attack hit, make another attack roll with advantage, dealing an additional 3d6 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or more on the second attack, the target's AC is reduced by 1 until its next long rest. This effect stacks up to three times.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 2d8  and 3d8 at level 5, 5d4 and 3d10 at level 10, and 4d8 and 3d12 at level 17.

Steel.name: Flash Cannon
Steel.description: You gather energy from the light around you and send a concentrated beam towards a creature in range. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 19 or 20, the next attack against the target is rolled at advantage.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Formation Strike
Steel.description: While leading a formation, you command your forces to attack in unison. Make a melee attack roll against a target, dealing 1d6 + MOVE steel damage for each creature in your formation.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to d8 at level 5, d10 at level 10, and d12 at level 17.

Steel.name: Gear Grind
Steel.description: You send a pair of steel gears at up to two targets in range. Make two ranged attacks, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage with each hit.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Gear Up
Steel.description: You engage your gears to raise the attack of ally creatures in range with the Plus or Minus ability. While you maintain your concentration, Pokémon under the effects of Gear Up have advantage on all attack rolls.

Steel.name: Gold Rush
Steel.description: You strike a target, causing coins to scatter everywhere. Make a melee attack, doing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. In addition, 10x the sum of the user’s level + the damage rolled in cash is scattered as gold dust on the floor until the end of combat.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Gyro Ball
Steel.description: You tackle a creature with a high-speed spin. Make a melee attack against a creature, dealing 1d6 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If your DEX score is lower than the target's, double the dice roll for damage.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Heavy Slam
Steel.description: You slam into a creature with your heavy body. Make a melee attack on a target, dealing a minimum of 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. Add an additional bonus to damage equal to your MOVE modifier for each size level you are above a creature. (Sizes, in order, are: Tiny, Small, Medium, Large, Huge, Gigantic)
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Industrial Solvent
Steel.description: You unleash a powerful industrial cleaning solution in a wide cone. All creatures in a 40-foot cone must make a CON save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE steel damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. This move deals double damage to Poison-type and Steel-type Pokémon. Steel type creatures and creatures wearing metal armor that fail the save have their AC reduced by 1 for 1 minute (this effect stacks up to -3 AC). The entire area is thoroughly cleaned and sterilized.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Iron Defense
Steel.description: Your body temporarily becomes solid as steel plate. Until your next turn, you gain + 6 to your AC and have resistance to all types of damage. If you were vulnerable, you now take regular damage. If you were already resistant, you become immune.

Steel.name: Iron Head
Steel.description: You slam into the target with your hard head. Make a melee attack, dealing 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or higher, the target flinches.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Iron Tail
Steel.description: You swing your tail out, attempting to crush a creature. Make an attack roll on a creature in range, doing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is a 19 or 20, the target’s AC is decreased by 1 for the rest of combat.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: King's Shield
Steel.description: Your body is cloaked with a protective shield that negates all damage to you. When targeted by an attack, you may automatically avoid taking damage from this attack and any other damaging move until the beginning of your next turn. You may still suffer secondary effects. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful.

Steel.name: Magnet Bomb
Steel.description: You hurl a steel ball that seeks out a creature in range, never missing. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d10 + MOVE steel damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Maintenance
Steel.description: You perform emergency maintenance on a creature or structure. Touch one target to restore 3d10 + MOVE hit points. If used on a structure or object instead, it is reinforced, gaining +5 AC and resistance to all damage types for 1 hour. This move can be used 3 times per long rest.
Steel.scaling: The healing dice roll for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Metal Burst
Steel.description: You lash out in retaliation with a bust of harsh metal shards. As a reaction, when you are hit with a melee attack that deals damage, make a melee attack roll against your attacker, with disadvantage. On a hit, deal the same amount of damage rolled as steel type damage back at your attacker. In the unlikely event of a natural 20, the target will suffer from bleeding wounds for 3 rounds, losing HP equal to its proficiency bonus each time it spends VP or uses its movement during this time.

Steel.name: Metal Claw
Steel.description: You strike out with sharp claws. Make a melee attack roll against a creature, doing 1d6 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 19 or 20, add your proficiency bonus to your next attack.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Metal Sound
Steel.description: You emit an ear-shattering high pitched sound that only your target can hear, leaving them in a defenseless state. When activating this move, a target must make a CON saving throw against your Move DC. On a failure, all attack rolls against the target are given a +5 bonus until the end of your next turn.

Steel.name: Meteor Mash
Steel.description: You smash a creature with a fist as fast as a meteor strike. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. If the natura attack roll is 18 or higher, your next attack has advantage.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Mirror Shot
Steel.description: You loose a damaging flash of light from your polished body. Make a ranged attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, the target has disadvantage on its next attack roll.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Parry
Steel.description: When subject to any targeted attack with a STR or DEX move power, you may use your reaction to attempt to parry it. Make a contested roll against your opponent's Strength or Dexterity ability score. On a higher roll, you take no damage from the attack, but may still suffer other effects. On a natural roll of 19 or higher, you succeed, suffer no effects and retain your reaction this round.
Steel.scaling: The treshold for retaining your reaction drops to 18 at level 5, 17 at level 10 and 16 at level 17.

Steel.name: Sentinel Strike
Steel.description: When a targeted attack would hit an ally adjacent to you, you can choose to take the damage instead. If you do, your next attack against that target has advantage.

Steel.name: Shield Dome
Steel.description: You emit a strong vibration, creating a dome barrier in a 15ft. radius around you. For the duration, creatures must succeed a Strength check against your move DC in order to pass through the barrier, and ranged attacks can't pass through it. You may allow a creature to pass through, automatically succeeding the saving throw.

Steel.name: Shield Guardian
Steel.description: You protect a creature next to you from an incoming targeted attack by moving to block it, negating all damage and effects. On future instances of this move in the same combat, you must roll higher than a 15 on a d20 roll for the reaction to be successful, or suffer the damage and effects yourself.

Steel.name: Shift Gear
Steel.description: You rotate your gears quickly, raising your attack and speed. When you activate this move, add +1 to your attack and damage rolls, and +10 to your speed for the duration. At the start of each of your turns while active, spend 2 VP or the effect ends.
Steel.scaling: The attack and damage roll bonus for this move changes to +2 at level 5, +3 at level 10, and +4 at level 17.

Steel.name: Smart Strike
Steel.description: You pinpoint the perfect place to strike a creature with a horn as strong as steel. This move is guaranteed to hit for 1d6 + MOVE steel damage, unless during the invulnerable stage of Fly, Dig, Bounce, Dive, etc. moves.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Sqeegee Slash
Steel.description: You slash with a blade-like cleaning edge. Make a melee attack roll, dealing 2d8 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on a natural attack roll of 18 or higher. On a critical hit, the target's AC is reduced by 1 until their next long rest, stacking up to -5. This move leaves a perfectly clean streak on any surface struck.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Steel.name: Steel Wing
Steel.description: You strike a target hard with outstretched wings. Make a melee attack on a creature, doing 1d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Steel.name: Sunsteel Strike
Steel.description: You slam into the target with the force of a meteor. Make a melee attack, dealing 4d12 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. This move ignores any abilities of the target creature that would decrease its ability to hit or deal full damage.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Steel.name: Wealth's Burden
Steel.description: You smash into a creature with your metal fist. Make a melee attack against a creature, doing 3d10 + MOVE steel damage on a hit. On a hit, the target must succeed a STR saving throw or fall prone. If the natural attack roll is 16 or higher, the target's speed is reduced by half until the end of its next turn.
Steel.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Aqua Jet
Water.description: You lunge at an opponent with incredible speed. At the beginning of a round of combat, you may announce that you are using this move, immediately jumping to the top of the initiative order for that round only. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Aqua Phase
Water.description: You disappear from view and prepare to surprise a target with an attack. When you activate this move, you become invisible and immune to any attacks of opportunity. You cannot be targeted by attacks while you are invisible. On your next turn, you use may your action to reappear at a point within range and make a melee attack against a creature, with advantage, dealing 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a successful hit. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Aqua Ring
Water.description:
You surround yourself with a veil of healing
water. At the end of each of your turns, as long as you hold
concentration, regain a number of hit points equal to your
level.

Water.name: Aqua Tail
Water.description:
You lash out with your tail to strike an opponent. Make a melee attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage
on a hit.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Astral Jet
Water.description: You lunge at an opponent with incredible speed. At the beginning of a round of combat, you may announce that you are using this move, immediately  jumping to the top of the initiative order for that round only. Make a melee attack on an opponent, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit. You partially phase out of existence. Protect and Detect reactions may not be used when hit by this attack.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Brine
Water.description: You send a harsh blast of salt water at an opponent. Make a ranged attack against an opponent, dealing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. If the opponent has less than 50% of its max HP, double the damage dealt.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Bubble
Water.description: You shoot a series of quickly moving bubbles at a target. Make three ranged attacks, doing 1d4 water damage on each successful hit.
Water.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Bubble Beam
Water.description: You shoot a concentrated stream of bubbles in an 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All Pokémon caught in the line must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Clamp
Water.description:
You clamp down on an enemy Pokémon,
attempting to deal damage and keep them in place. Make a melee attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d6 + MOVE water damage and is grappled and restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to pry itself away with a STR save against your Move DC. As long as the target is restrained on your subsequent turns, this move can
be activated again as a bonus action with an automatic hit, dealing 1d6 water damage.
Water.scaling:
The damage dice roll for this move changes to
1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Crabhammer
Water.description: You slam down onto an opponent with a heavy claw. Make a melee attack roll on a target, dealing 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. This move scores a critical hit on rolls of 19 or 20.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

Water.name: Dive
Water.description: When you activate this move, you dive down and disappear into the Ethereal plane. You may not be targeted by attacks in the Ethereal plane. On your next turn, as an action, you reappear and attempt to strike an opponent from below. Make a melee attack roll on an opponent in range, with advantage, doing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Hydro Cannon
Water.description: You emit a powerful stream of high-speed water at creatures in an 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must make a DEX saving throw against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a failure, and half as much on a success. Creatures that fail the save also are pushed back 10 feet and fall prone. This move saps you of energy, and you may not make any attack until after the end of your next turn.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Hydro Pump
Water.description: You send a surge of powerful water towards creatures in a 80 foot line, 5 feet wide. All creatures caught in the blast must succeed on a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a failed save, and half as much on a success.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

Water.name: Ink Veil
Water.description: You surround yourself with a cloud of glowing ink, protecting from any status conditions for the duration. If you a condition is inflicted on you while Ink Veil is active, instead roll 3d10, regenerating that much HP and VP.
Water.scaling: The regeneration dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

Water.name: Muddy Water
Water.description: You summon a wave of muddy water in a 30ft. cone. All creatures caught in the wave must make a CON saving throw against your move DC, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a failure, half damage on a success. If an opponent fails the save by 5 or more, it has disadvantage on its next attack.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Oblivion Ink
Water.description: A strange ink emanates from your body, and descends on a creature in range, making them forgetful. Make a ranged attack, dealing 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. For 1d6 turns, the last move used by the creature is disabled.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

Water.name: Octazooka
Water.description: You send a blast of ink towards your creatures. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. If the natural attack roll is 18 or more, the target must add -1 to attack rolls for the remainder of this combat.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Origin Pulse
Water.description: Your body glows a bright and brilliant blue, sending three beams of focused light at any creature(s) in range. Make a ranged attack for each beam, dealing 4d12 + MOVE water damage on each successful hit.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Purge Current
Water.description:
You whip up a strong purifying vortex of water energy that clears field hazards and status conditions in the area. All creatures affected must succeed a STR saving throw or take 4d12 + MOVE water damage and be knocked prone. On a successfull save, they take half damage and are not knocked prone. For every hazard removed, and depending on the terrain, add 1d8 bonus damage of appropriate type for each element flung into the vortex (GM discretion).
Additionally, all creatures affected that suffer from a status condition must succeed a CON saving throw or lose their status condition, and take double damage.
If used underwater, the damage is rolled with advantage.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Rain Dance
Water.description: You summon a heavy rainfall that covers the battlefield for 5 rounds.

Water.name: Razor Shell
Water.description: You strike a creature with a razor sharp shell. Make a melee attack on a creature, dealing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On natural attack rolls of 18 or higher, lower the creatures AC by 1. This decrease may be stacked, up to a maximum of -5 to AC.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Sapphire Torrent
Water.description: You begin circling in the air at incredible speeds, creating a vortex of energy fed by atmospheric water for one turn. While charging this attack, your AC is temporarily increased by 5. On your next turn, the accumulated water is released all at once in a sparkling sapphire torrent in a 50 foot line. Any creature caught in the line must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a creature fails the save by more than 5, it is paralyzed, and frightened for three turns. During heavy rain, this move does not need charging.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Scald
Water.description: You instantly boil water within you to a damaging temperature, blasting a creature with its heat. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 16 or more, the target is burned.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Soak
Water.description: You fire a torrent of water at a creature with such force that it leaves lasting effects. Force a target in range to make a CON save against your Move DC. On a failure, their type changes to water for three rounds.

Water.name: Sparkling Aria
Water.description: You burst into song, unleashing a flurry of bubbles in a 10ft circle, centered on you. All creatures in range must make a DEX save or take 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a fail and half as much on a save. Any creature suffering from the burned condition will be cured upon touching the bubbles.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Steam Eruption
Water.description: You shoot out a cone of intensely hot steam from your body, immersing creatures in range. All creatures in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC, taking 3d10 + MOVE water damage on a failure, or half as much on a success. If a target fails the save by 5 or more, it becomes burned.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 5d8 at level 5, 6d10 at level 10, and 10d8 at level 17

Water.name: Surf
Water.description: You create a powerful wave that crashes down on creatures in a 30 foot cone. Any creature caught in the blast must make a DEX saving throw, taking 2d8 + MOVE water damage and falling prone on a failure, or half as much without falling prone on a success.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Surface Glide
Water.description: You channel water energy to boost your movement. Gain double speed on and in water. While this effect is active, you don't provoke attacks of opportunity. If it is raining, all surfaces are considered to be water for you.

Water.name: Water Gun
Water.description: You fire a quick spurt of water at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d6 + MOVE water damage on a hit.
Water.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d8 at level 5, 1d10 at level 10, and 2d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Water Pledge
Water.description: You send a column of water towards a creature. Make a ranged attack, dealing 2d8 + MOVE water damage on a hit. After you land a hit, any ally that uses another Pledge move in the same round automatically hits.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Water Pulse
Water.description: You send a wave of ultrasonic aquatic energy at a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll, dealing 1d10 + MOVE water damage on a hit. On a natural attack roll of 17 or higher, the target is confused.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Water Shuriken
Water.description: You fire a barrage of sharp shurikens at a target. Make a ranged attack roll, doing 1d4 + MOVE water damage on a hit. After successfully hitting a target, roll a d4. On a result of 3 or 4, another shuriken strikes the target for an additional 1d4 water damage. Continue this process until you fail to roll a 3 or 4 on the d4 roll, up to a maximum of four additional hits.
Water.scaling: The damage dice roll for this move changes to 1d6 at level 5, 1d8 at level 10, and 1d10 at level 17.

Water.name: Water Sport
Water.description: You soak yourself and all allies with water, reducing the amount of fire damage taken for anyone affected. For the duration, you and any ally in range (when you initially activated this move) have resistance to fire-type attacks. If you were already resistant, you are now immune If you were vulnerable, you now take normal damage. If you are immune to fire-type moves already, nothing happens.

Water.name: Water Spout
Water.description: You fire a blast of water at a creature that increases in power the more healthy you are. Make a ranged attack roll against a creature, doing 4d12 + MOVE water damage on a hit if you are at or above 50% of your health. If you are below 50%, halve the total damage done.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 6d12 at level 5, 8d12 at level 10, and 14d12 at level 17.

Water.name: Waterfall
Water.description: You create an intense waterfall that crashes down on creatures in a 10 foot radius, centered on a point within range. Creatures in the area must make a DEX save against your Move DC or take 2d8 + MOVE water damage and fall prone on a fail, or half as much on a save.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 3d8 at level 5, 4d8 at level 10, and 6d8 at level 17.

Water.name: Whirlpool
Water.description: You create a wave of water that swirls around a creature in range. Make a ranged attack roll. On a hit, the target takes 1d10 + MOVE water damage and is restrained. At the beginning of each of its turns, it may attempt to escape with a STR save against your Move DC. On each successive turn, if the creature is still restrained, you may use this move again (as an action) and automatically hit.
Water.scaling: The damage dice for this move changes to 2d6 at level 5, 2d8 at level 10, and 4d6 at level 17.

Water.name: Withdraw
Water.description: When subject to a melee or ranged attack, you can spend your reaction to increase your AC by +2 if it would cause the attack to miss.
Water.scaling: Increase your AC by +3 at level 10 and above.
